          <h1 title="Google Workspace connector tools" itemprop="name">
            Google Workspace connector tools
            
          </h1>

          
          <div class="flex">
            <div class="media">
              
              
                <div class="media-body font-size-md align-self-center">
                  
                  <ul class="list-divider">
                    
                      <li class="text-gray-600">
                        
                          Updated
                          <time datetime="2026-05-14T18:10:45Z" title="05/14/2026, 20:10" data-datetime="relative">1 month ago</time>
                        
                      </li>
                    
                    
                  </ul>
                </div>
              

              
                
                <div class="subscribe-article">
                  <div><button type="button" id="follow-button-0.40455075568420507" data-auth-action="signin" data-follower-count="0" data-selected="false" aria-describedby="subscriptons-description-0.822280619105085" aria-label="Follow Article" aria-pressed="false">Follow</button><span class="IJDXXdfgVXcY6MRd9u66HghwrbdhBtJv" id="subscriptons-description-0.822280619105085">Not yet followed by anyone</span></div>

        <section class="content article-content mb-6" itemprop="articleBody">
          <p>The Google Workspace connector tools in Optimizely Opal let you read and interact with your Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Calendar data directly from Opal Chat, agents, and workflows. This article explains how administrators install and configure the tools in Optimizely Connect Platform (OCP), and how users authenticate to start using them.</p><h2 id="h_01K86CPG4DW356CY1JZDQ3A2DV">Add the Google Workspace Tool for Opal in OCP<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01K86CPG4DW356CY1JZDQ3A2DV"></a></h2><figure class="wysiwyg-media"><div data-oembed-url="https://optimizely.wistia.com/medias/v0az976ygq"><iframe src="//fast.wistia.com/embed/iframe/v0az976ygq" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="" allow="encrypted-media" style="width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;"></iframe></div></figure><h3 id="h_01KQCZPA6KM20WPHSJ36H612CC">Install the Google Workspace Tool for Opal in OCP<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KQCZPA6KM20WPHSJ36H612CC"></a></h3><p data-start="1281" data-end="1349">In the OCP <strong>App Directory</strong>, complete the following:</p><ol>
<li data-list-item-id="ec611b421fd7e2e3bc2c9bbe3305d2f8b">
<p>Click <strong>Google Workspace Tool for Opal</strong>.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1770/1088;" src="/hc/article_attachments/45503026034573" alt="Screenshot of OCP App Directory where the Google Workspace Tool for Opal connector is highlighted" width="1770" height="1088" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edcb4ad312bd7fafa706255c132e7469e">
<p>Click <strong>Install App</strong>.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1758/1184;" src="/hc/article_attachments/45471460052749" alt="Screenshot of OCP App Directory where the Install App button is highlighted" width="1758" height="1184" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
</ol><h3 id="h_01KQCZPSNAX6A3M1K4K2ZFHGEW">Configure the Google Workspace settings<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KQCZPSNAX6A3M1K4K2ZFHGEW"></a></h3><p>After installing the Google Workspace app, you must configure it in OCP.</p><p><strong>Google Workspace settings</strong></p><p><span data-teams="true">This section is to manage your own OAuth provider and is not common. See </span><a href="#h_01KQFJTYB0QEB6JVH4TCKMRTZ3"><span data-teams="true">Configure instance level Opal OAuth</span></a><span data-teams="true"> for instructions.</span></p><p><strong>Tool configuration</strong></p><ol>
<li data-list-item-id="e565d35696dce4b91d15a36238d6ac182">Expand the <strong>Tool Configuration </strong>section.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0b9ea2618efc4812d19a75213991dc6d">Toggle individual Google Workspace services on or off.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3417c1e0d441222e5db6e7e764bf6ffd">
<p>Click <strong>Save</strong>.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1254/1142;" src="/hc/article_attachments/45471456080141" alt="Screenshot of the Tool Configuration section in OCP where individual Google Workspace service toggles are visible" width="1254" height="1142" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e776c057f3d50b390534da6764a3b6b4f">Expand the corresponding permissions sections and toggle individual tools on or off for the services you toggled on. See the <a href="#h_01KQD2CMM8WE776AT7G0WNPKH9">Google Workspace connector tools </a>section for a list of tools that each permission enables.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8969444b13cc7c9f8b49dccdbd81fc08">
<p>Click <strong>Save</strong> for each section.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img class="wysiwyg-image img-enlargable" style="aspect-ratio: 1290/1084;" src="/hc/article_attachments/45471456081037" alt="Screenshot of expanded permissions sections in OCP where individual tool toggles are visible for a Google Workspace service" width="1290" height="1084"></figure>
</li>
</ol><p><strong>Add to Opal</strong></p><ol>
<li data-list-item-id="e2217b5c4262fddcf2891da5f5ad9b99b">Expand the <strong>Add to Opal</strong> section.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2e765e9a49c5e2e43e8c970fb21fcf5e">
<p>Click <strong>Add to Opal</strong> to register the Google Workspace tools in the corresponding Opal instance.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1288/1004;" src="/hc/article_attachments/45471456085517" alt="Screenshot of the Add to Opal section in OCP where the Add to Opal button is highlighted" width="1288" height="1004" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
</ol><h2 id="h_01KKM8P1NHRF3S9TBZQQP09C87">Authenticate with Google Workspace<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KKM8P1NHRF3S9TBZQQP09C87"></a></h2><p>After an administrator <a href="#h_01K86CPG4DW356CY1JZDQ3A2DV">adds the Google Workspace Tool for Opal in OCP</a>, log in from Opal to access your information. The Google Workspace connector tools use user-level authorization. Each user can only access data they are permitted to view in Google.</p><p>To authenticate, complete the following steps in Opal:</p><ol>
<li data-list-item-id="e4b5cb5a1ee0cfa751893a84b4fe0963c">Go to <strong>Tools > Connectors</strong>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eaa5b05e9a92df558fc17890bd86e9845">
<p>Click <strong>Connect</strong> for the Google Workspace tools.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1844/1126;" src="/hc/article_attachments/45503035773325" width="1844" height="1126" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e52a56d9f50b0e706cde32019e3662cbd">Log in to Google.</li>
</ol><p>After you connect to Google, the Google Workspace connector tools become available in <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/36343492268813" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Opal Chat</a>, <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39407442255245" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">agents</a>, and <a href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/39417564742797" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">workflows</a>.</p><h2 id="h_01KQD2CMM8WE776AT7G0WNPKH9">Google Workspace connector tools<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KQD2CMM8WE776AT7G0WNPKH9"></a></h2><p>After an administrator <a href="#h_01K86CPG4DW356CY1JZDQ3A2DV" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">adds the Google Workspace Tool in OCP</a> and you <a href="#h_01KKM8P1NHRF3S9TBZQQP09C87">log in to Google</a>, the following tools are available in Opal.</p><p>Expand a tool to see when to use it, required and optional parameters, and example prompts. If you do not provide a required parameter, Opal prompts you for it.</p><h3 id="h_01KQD2EFHK1KWCEDQYJMKTQ6A2">Google Calendar<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KQD2EFHK1KWCEDQYJMKTQ6A2"></a></h3><p>The Google Calendar tools let you create, retrieve, update, and delete calendar events directly from Opal. Use them to schedule meetings, manage your calendar, and coordinate availability without leaving your current workflow.</p><h4 id="h_01KQFZ9HNRDRS6DE34VH65GJJJ">Read</h4><details><summary><code>google_calendar_get_event</code> – Retrieves a specific event from a Google Calendar.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea3a963fd64da514380731cc9ab70ef93">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e211b4b01d6883cd052645e1ee30f807f">Read complete details and descriptions of a specific event.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e377a8c1e63529e8c32441012ec1c3da2">View the attendee list, emails, and their RSVP response statuses.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7825ca9f9cf3440dc4a2150eff842993">Check event configurations like visibility, status, or time zone information.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8eb82bb5cced3739233bf28065a1bd38">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e4205e22dbabd59a6582cdc5da022f9c1">
<code>eventId</code> – Unique event identifier. Opaque string between 5-1024 characters, obtained from event creation or list operations.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef71839f7eafbf6f1cfd3a1a552bf3e8a">(Optional) <code>calendarId</code> – Calendar identifier.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed70fa7c234fa58fa9d9f518c71fe6bb7">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e49271e9fd03cdabc1ae54b94dab5c1fa"><em>Get the details for the "Monthly Review" meeting.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e66338268446a9cbc7ff5f091b4c4e172"><em>Who has accepted the invite for my 10 AM event?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eab8625cd3a66110fcf9a267353cf0950"><em>Retrieve the event details for event ID xyz789abc.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_calendar_list_calendars</code> – Lists all calendars on the user's calendar list.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4257652898f53b961d2d8b8af1601f74">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ea062bb584b49fdae0151e2941891fdd9">Find all available calendars a user has access to (for example, shared or primary).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec8170895b7978230f832a229559a90b1">Obtain calendar IDs needed to perform operations on specific calendars.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e375c7fee6c3fd7154f61cd3cf256afa1">Check calendar access permissions and roles.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eaa9793dd3b0d20fa2a4a03f147b469bb">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed793c598ee9d904dc1f2357de401f5bf">(Optional) <code>maxResults</code> – Maximum number of calendars to return per page. Default: 50.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e08c1e7e8ac24aa00ae027da9c603e7df">(Optional) <code>pageToken</code> – Token for retrieving the next page of results. Use the <code>nextPageToken</code> from the previous response.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e00714ee8f7fd4687438302b5fc66ddee">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e27851bc86b3134b6aa3329b62b0903b1"><em>List all the calendars I have access to.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e74d894118ac0e443f39c23d8f1528988"><em>What is the calendar ID for my "Marketing Team" shared calendar?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e091f36f7a2049409cd278a40fa7c9a20"><em>Show me the first 10 calendars in my Google account.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_calendar_list_events</code> – Lists events from a specified Google Calendar.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e567bc590ae79f5d3121747a070991f54">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb1a646adbbcfbbe9df20496d026c01dd">Retrieve a list of upcoming events for the day or week.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edb063690810355e75045fadf3463b634">Search for specific meetings across all calendars using keywords.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eaaf2ec6ed52ff855c083862bb31e7f6b">Find events within a specific date and time range.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb927e2d18a76e17f62d2f6233752af54">Identify open time slots for scheduling.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e864b5380ac1949f262ac7d2b329153c3">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e1739b34f74c0a28771efbb4596629bd2">(Optional) <code>calendarId</code> – Calendar identifier.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e97d61c9645d14f8730e840867165dc65">(Optional) <code>maxResults</code> – Maximum number of events to return per page. Default: 10.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0a2d2bff653fe7ea50601f6fe007e18d">(Optional) <code>pageToken</code> – Token for retrieving the next page of results. Use the <code>nextPageToken</code> from the previous response.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea6f889261e6a273c1853de7b29a3d488">(Optional) <code>q</code> – Free text search query. Searches event summary, description, location, attendee names and emails. Case-insensitive.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e87fe46b6adddbd99df3f511237809c72">(Optional) <code>searchAllCalendars</code> – Search events across all user calendars (primary, subscribed, shared, and so on). When <code>false</code> or omitted, only the specified calendar (or <code>primary</code>) is searched. Set <code>searchAllCalendars</code> to <code>true</code> to find events regardless of which calendar is specified.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea298d9e7846dee87acc0a600c0c87ab2">(Optional) <code>timeMax</code> – Upper bound (exclusive) for event start time in RFC3339 format. Example: "2023-12-31T23:59:59-05:00"</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e23abb7aa624877f5d88b9e6038be55db">(Optional) <code>timeMin</code> – Lower bound (inclusive) for event start time in RFC3339 format. Example: "2023-12-01T00:00:00-05:00"</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed9448b799b38b0fff473c94c9145a7ca">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef17ad55cd4a32fa455fa1c56535e7745"><em>What is on my calendar for today?</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec027c920bfcb01304f17ee0d3a76c2fa"><em>List my events for next week between Monday and Wednesday.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e42aa6fb39deaf857176ef31f9bf72bac"><em>Search all my calendars for any meetings mentioning "Budget".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edf4b08114b0482d2c577a4420f92f6c4"><em>Show me my next 5 upcoming meetings.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h4 id="h_01KQFZ9M4HTDATN0Z42D13JRDA">Write</h4><details><summary><code>google_calendar_create_event</code> – Creates a new event in a Google Calendar.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e12075611a005e75e2d6966fbfcd8f4be">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8b409b8d43e65f7527198d73524133c1">Schedule new meetings, appointments, or events.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed65a4316fa0bab97c983c02111b8e986">Create all-day or multi-day out-of-office entries.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e60c23930c2f8c193d027af153ccb5cc9">Create an event and immediately add attendees to send invitations.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecf132c21a74e4bc22502a19fef30d14e">Create recurring events with specific recurrence rules.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed1760691fde436dde9d9b994efe19e46">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e317515f2d6a4612ed282245b7f79cdab">
<code>startDateTime</code> – Event start date and time. For timed events: RFC3339 format like "2023-12-15T14:00:00-05:00" or "2023-12-15T19:00:00Z". For all-day events: Date-only format like "2026-02-26" (YYYY-MM-DD, no time component).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e53350bb5f9b8081d92022792bf16e4a2">
<code>endDateTime</code> – Event end date and time. For all-day events: Date-only format. End date is exclusive. For a three-day event from the 26th through the 28th, use <code>start="2026-02-26", end="2026-03-01"</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eadce9c0c8d22f9a77f07889a2ee7857f">
<code>summary</code> – Event title or name. Displays as the main event heading in calendar views. Can contain HTML.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e42bce828a85fddc3a9c4faf6f4c7afcb">(Optional) <code>attendees</code> – Valid email addresses of invitees as a comma-separated string, JSON array string, or single email. Examples: "user@example.com" or "user1@example.com,user2@example.com" or ["user1@example.com","user2@example.com"]</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e511e46d6c072d55c5d2c6b38cd6caa3f">(Optional) <code>calendarId</code> – Calendar identifier.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee68482ced922a9da88828ad7fbc0d819">(Optional) <code>colorId</code> – Color ID for the event (1-11). Sets the color of the event in calendar views.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef3011eac34fe52d07b1ddd2eb4ffd8ec">
<p>(Optional) <code>conferenceData</code> – Conference data for video meetings (for example, Google Meet). Example:</p>
<pre class="language-json">{
  "createRequest": {
    "requestId": "unique-id-123",
    "conferenceSolutionKey": {
      "type": "hangoutsMeet"
    }
  }
}</pre>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e95fc0545699555a95b66b514d6664328">(Optional) <code>description</code> – Event description or details. Can contain HTML formatting for rich text, links, and styling.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e352c39391e2e2bc1e1862747b4fc3708">(Optional) <code>eventType</code> – Specifies special event categories. Event type: <code>default</code>, <code>outOfOffice</code>, <code>focusTime</code>, or <code>workingLocation</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5e422de78f9197d1ffbcd1c92aee1f85">(Optional) <code>guestsCanInviteOthers</code> – Whether attendees other than the organizer can invite others to the event. Default: <code>true</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e391366a60325a12f2c8c9c1c14953219">(Optional) <code>guestsCanModify</code> – Whether attendees other than the organizer can modify the event. Default: <code>false</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efad4792fc730655ab703d99f0ec4c568">(Optional) <code>guestsCanSeeOtherGuests</code> – Whether attendees other than the organizer can see who the event's attendees are. Default: <code>true</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e182dae80edbff0a8a42cc03f60140d74">(Optional) <code>location</code> – Geographic location as free-form text. Can be address, room name, or virtual meeting link.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e52d90f2875b20fa6f667b12e5da3fba7">(Optional) <code>recurrence</code> – <code>RRULE</code>, <code>EXRULE</code>, <code>RDATE</code>, and <code>EXDATE</code> lines for recurring events as a comma-separated string or JSON array string. Examples: "RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=10" or ["RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=10","EXDATE:20240101T120000Z"]</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1445a497ee006330c43eb7dc7fd3ab48">
<p>(Optional) <code>reminders</code> – Reminder settings with <code>useDefault</code> (boolean) and optional overrides array. If <code>useDefault</code> is <code>true</code>, calendar default reminders apply. If <code>useDefault</code> is <code>false</code>, specify custom reminders in overrides array. Example:</p>
<pre class="language-json"> {
  "useDefault": false,
  "overrides": [
    {
      "method": "email",
      "minutes": 60
    },
    {
      "method": "popup",
      "minutes": 10
    }
  ]
}</pre>
<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e60035c7fec2b7038a88fe65c9268057a">
<strong>Valid methods</strong> – <code>email</code>, <code>popup</code>, and <code>sms</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8f56beb3bbf7366264b8c3a35421a9be">
<strong>Minutes range</strong> – 0–40320 (four weeks).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea4991fc36296e0c9454b609c09766ab7">(Optional) <code>status</code> – Indicates the event state. Event status: <code>confirmed</code>, <code>tentative</code>, or <code>cancelled</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efd54c6a7ebe47b2b1bb921eb9ffbabe8">(Optional) <code>timeZone</code> – Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) Time Zone Database name (for example, "America/New_York" or "Europe/London"). Applied to both start and end times.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e585c509879c80f1b709a790857f4795c">(Optional) <code>visibility</code> – Controls who can see event details. Event visibility: <code>default</code>, <code>public</code>, <code>private</code>, or <code>confidential</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee62d8612ac10d1c30a709f265a83a413">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edda3d158c353618788f05e7a026e511b"><em>Create a project kickoff meeting tomorrow from 10 AM to 11 AM called "Q3 Planning".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e198f50317afa42e0ba750c008fd5e73b"><em>Schedule an all-day out-of-office event for next Friday.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4fb678687d91eb817a0d0d014dace512"><em>Create a sync with marketing@example.com on Monday at 3 PM for 30 minutes.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb3b406d3e04f32886094927cf72c6d64"><em>Draft a weekly recurring meeting starting next Tuesday at 9 AM called "Team Sync".</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_calendar_delete_event</code> – Deletes an event from a Google Calendar.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1b439f712daa0439108fc7723cfc6875">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e347eef1a22e20c88f0a1ec32739695ce">Cancel existing events or appointments.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef38b1f9b7b01718318cfa2b2018cf1db">Remove outdated, canceled, or duplicate calendar entries.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eef98f4192a762536e81737dd27ea8909">Delete specific instances of a recurring event series.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eaaf31c2f49e05037903c103b712ade8c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="edc164eaf548db117c28d687159dcaa5b">
<code>eventId</code> – Unique event identifier to delete. Opaque string between 5-1024 characters, obtained from event creation or list operations.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e03f0822bddcfdda42f0c7e695d142ff0">(Optional) <code>calendarId</code> – Calendar identifier.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e95cff008751cb44fd1f8da201e2641ce">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e30997f440c75d68e8e0586d50a709a1e"><em>Cancel my 4 PM meeting today.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e8522e200b80dd9ac163b723ccea3b74e"><em>Delete the team sync event from my calendar.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e580e3245bf130d1544600b366e2e4883"><em>Remove the event with ID abc123def456 from my calendar.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_calendar_update_event</code> – Updates an existing event in a Google Calendar.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eb5823852423e79c6322f3d4d5f8baaab">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eda3cf99a82a6143db38d1b367222ac33">Reschedule an event to a new date or time.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1804d963bd72d8b2d4945e9a8e77f74f">Add or remove attendees from an existing meeting.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7396ab08e794a91dee133378ed747914">Update the description, location, or title of an existing calendar event.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e52677460f554447e6a3e34e85e8588f6">Convert an all-day event to a timed event (or vice versa).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e4ca186cabac5f83ae27ea170002732c1">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="efcede099e1e17b3121e4d2155af95955">
<code>eventId</code> – Unique event identifier. Opaque string between 5-1024 characters, generated by Google Calendar API.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e54123a4b107edab61dba5c060df3f6d7">(Optional) <code>attendees</code> – Valid email addresses of invitees as a comma-separated string, JSON array string, or single email. Examples: "user@example.com" or "user1@example.com,user2@example.com" or ["user1@example.com","user2@example.com"]</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed84d71fc6a1ab7650554e86f8bb98c78">(Optional) <code>calendarId</code> – Calendar identifier.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee525cc3956dfdf093cb58262afd87d54">(Optional) <code>description</code> – Event description or details. Can contain HTML formatting for rich text, links, and basic styling.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2f76ea86d660da7c54304a5f918c71f2">(Optional) <code>endDateTime</code> – Event end time. Must be after <code>startDateTime</code>. For timed events: RFC3339 format. For all-day events: Date-only format (end date is EXCLUSIVE). Must match startDateTime format (both all-day or both timed).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edae666978ea204f58cca82291828aef4">(Optional) <code>location</code> – Geographic location as free-form text. Can be address, room name, or virtual meeting link.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed2cd2071c5eff2098c21ea0d6c8b1422">(Optional) <code>sendUpdates</code> – Notification policy: <code>all</code> (notify all attendees), <code>externalOnly</code> (external attendees only), or <code>none</code> (no notifications).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2b6bfa8defba1ac4d899701f770dcf15">(Optional) <code>startDateTime</code> – Event start time. For timed events: RFC3339 format like "2023-12-15T14:00:00-05:00" or "2023-12-15T19:00:00Z". For all-day events: Date-only format like "2026-03-04" (YYYY-MM-DD). Can convert between formats (all-day to timed or vice versa).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eaa2adb23a9cdb9fc4fa2cf6a864d967c">(Optional) <code>status</code> – Event status: <code>confirmed</code> (default and final), <code>tentative</code> (provisional), <code>cancelled</code> (deleted but visible in incremental sync).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecfcfe740a33788c2fc0042eac237198d">(Optional) <code>summary</code> – Event title and name. Can contain HTML formatting. This is the main event heading shown in calendar views.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4e41976cfd062683c3bf8773a90e66bb">(Optional) <code>timeZone</code> – IANA Time Zone Database name (for example, "America/New_York", "Europe/London", "Asia/Tokyo"). Applied to start and end times.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee39e9d30ed9d6fb09a2d6b0c78857d94">(Optional) <code>visibility</code> – Event visibility: <code>default</code> (calendar default), <code>public</code> (visible to all), <code>private</code> (attendees only), or <code>confidential</code> (legacy private).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1ac4c7360af2aca0e347b72586aebc61">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e9bd2be737c58c9affc2a2c8bee337fad"><em>Move my 3 PM meeting today to 4 PM instead.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea79e79cf5a9b9197b35bba9b97ee45b2"><em>Add emily@example.com to the "Q3 Review" event tomorrow.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e057650a4589f57d62f37a94c6e22d84d"><em>Rename the "Sync" meeting to "Weekly Project Sync".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e04cccf4cd88cb28ffaba29d3508a6266"><em>Update the location of my 10 AM meeting to "Conference Room B".</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h3 id="h_01KQD2GJESVS6W4Z1FJ5A11B48">Google Docs<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KQD2GJESVS6W4Z1FJ5A11B48"></a></h3><p>The Google Docs tools let you create, read, edit, and format documents directly from Opal. Use them to insert and style content, manage tables, find and replace text, and work with images without leaving your current workflow.</p><h4 id="h_01KQFZ8N5CC8FG1T6SB2HK6BGY">Read</h4><details><summary><code>google_docs_find_document_by_name</code> – Search for Google Docs documents by name. Supports both exact and fuzzy matching.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eae5a56da3b07431c911984b01476d0ae">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3a0d636ec4bd984ed2031980bb0ecb79">Locate the internal ID of a Google Doc using its human-readable title.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec2d0a0a20a8e03096de0850516ec8c05">Fuzzy search your Google Drive to find documents related to a certain topic or keyword.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec819fcd5e5d155e2235cfed38357b519">Get the shareable view link and metadata for a specific document file.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e0403095271572378e1d461e395ec5940">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="efb35d0252603e97d8ff14590bb387e88">
<code>name</code> – The name or partial name of the document to search for</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecf3dadb566f44eb173d74ff52cc5793d">(Optional) <code>exactMatch</code> – Whether to match the exact name (case-sensitive) or use fuzzy matching. Default is <code>false</code> for fuzzy matching.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e31d4cd5bae35a80aa213ccbb7c7dcdaf">(Optional) <code>maxResults</code> – Maximum number of documents to return. Default is 10.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="edb60ff9b101fc4041a9141b2458bc3c8">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e47bd982f634dae7c3d3a5e1a374b8ccd"><em>Find the Google Doc named "2024 Strategy Review".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ebbdc498631e4e81cab87af23f9c378af"><em>Search for any documents matching the title "Invoice Template".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e93c236ef686f82bfffefe1311708acab"><em>Look up exactly the document titled "Q3 Analytics Report" and return its ID.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_get_document</code> – Get a Google Docs document by its ID. Returns the full document structure.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="efdfc5b7227b3b4df2abde4e6d87cd2aa">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ea603c31d4cfcd5bb9799ec5b629dac9b">Fetch the entire structural JSON tree of a document for deep analysis.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e07978ef0337a31c5d789ce79fb3b8923">Find the exact insertion indices (like paragraph start indices) before editing text or modifying table cells.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecc687bb9bea2d4d1426d6e87cda87a1f">Retrieve metadata like titles, headers, and footers from a specific document.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef55afdbba1807f287a58af19900c2b31">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e721f416135d7cff14e6915a32eb8661d">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to retrieve</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6ac02b11190ee74b53adfd784d50ed8d">(Optional) <code>includeTabsContent</code> – Whether to populate the Document.tabs field instead of the text content fields</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb815de381af97132a538750fcb3e759b">(Optional) <code>suggestionsViewMode</code> – The suggestions view mode to apply to the document (DEFAULT_FOR_CURRENT_ACCESS, SUGGESTIONS_INLINE, PREVIEW_SUGGESTIONS_ACCEPTED, PREVIEW_WITHOUT_SUGGESTIONS)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ece7f621bb63bcd06ba8d5b7c809f1870">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3fc4d516168f8aabbf9d48c89a0688dc"><em>Retrieve the complete structure of document abc123 so I can see its contents.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec44f136e6b10f0374e0da76117e13629"><em>Get the Google Doc with ID xyz456 to find paragraph index locations.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec45721f60ae07def6936af20f50bee7e"><em>Fetch document info including tabs content for document def789.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_list_documents</code> – Get a list of Google Docs documents from your Google Drive. Supports pagination and sorting options.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8490ad04572490769471e593f23df3ea">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e148f6a7c4eed74924d260a93bf9891e0">View recently modified Google Docs in your Drive.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e11b83bea9e8ea086576981af008728ae">Fetch the IDs and metadata for a batch of documents all at once.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eded2c4a6aa7bd9b927d2bcf7cca2932b">Look up a paginated list of shared or trashed files.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e7d578a8d81d1f6434ce2a42dec92ba1f">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5403b37f29aca800ad22c0ccd440e564">(Optional) <code>includeShared</code> – Whether to include documents shared with you (not just owned by you). Default is true.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee2288dfaf585972bfed70e4bff9bca93">(Optional) <code>includeTrashed</code> – Whether to include trashed/deleted documents in results. Default is false.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebe6dc0b343d896995e341af423292dc7">(Optional) <code>maxResults</code> – Maximum number of documents to return (1-100). Default is 20.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3d4048b1a238cd8766ec6f8ec5655fc9">(Optional) <code>orderBy</code> – How to order the results. Options: name, createdTime, modifiedTime, recency. Default is modifiedTime.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebcdba72480005751501660b15b95d415">(Optional) <code>pageToken</code> – Token for pagination to get the next page of results</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed4bbfeff819de604534a7859f9cd08d2">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e1bd1b262eb99570ac21e7c19ca574276"><em>List my last 10 modified Google Docs.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e2e091f1f95377f81ebc8b99c5373bb97"><em>Show me all documents shared with me, sorted by name.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5d92272f0489afe80af2429d44a878c0"><em>Fetch the next page of documents in my Google Drive.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h4 id="h_01KQFZ8QPWW2CG05N2TRJ5RX97">Write</h4><details><summary><code>google_docs_create_document</code> – Create a new Google Docs document with the specified title.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e83c17dd9e01449753a3b0f2846af9c48">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef7f62ab2a8e43d43601eb1660ff8819a">Create a brand new Google Docs document from scratch.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec2217d5b23b90a04e48255a6f2348b87">Start a new document to begin taking notes or drafting content.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec11cd80058537d4c898485b889be20af">Generate a new working document to share with a team.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eef672bfe3cc0c7ac39f4df31f68dcfa3">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul><li data-list-item-id="ec4b979a35108030bd63fec0c7fd7ca27">
<code>title</code> – The title of the new document.</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eb7fc509347e7f2667c14df8c87fe4d26">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e12436f13622661e09fc65bfb130a5a6f"><em>Create a new Google Doc named "Project Alpha Requirements".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb074c32112dd3115a53046269e17248a"><em>Start a new document titled "Q4 Meeting Agenda".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eacda36e05cd010b36d489bb7fc84b714"><em>Make a blank document called "Draft Proposal".</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_delete_content_range</code> – Delete content from the specified range in the document.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eab4da10c869b467a17a013c792d80b97">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e6356ee3e8ad3116b07a7246ab9d73f8a">Remove a specific paragraph or section of text from a document.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e079c651d7a42f906d884ddf73007613c">Delete content between known start and end coordinates.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3e9a3ee9e7d0545201d40206165ecee7">Erase unwanted data programmatically from an existing template.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e63819bb5fe1467a3ac3e626265a661db">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e90206723ab2870edc29f98391b826e2a">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1639f86a87674538d2e97f2d52481346">
<code>range</code> – The range of content to delete. Deleting text that crosses a paragraph boundary may result in changes to paragraph styles, lists, positioned objects and bookmarks as the two paragraphs are merged. Attempting to delete certain ranges can result in an invalid document structure in which case a 400 bad request error is returned. The range of content to affect (object with segmentId, startIndex, endIndex, tabId properties). Object structure: {"segmentId": string, "startIndex": number, "endIndex": number, "tabId": string} *segmentId* - The ID of the header, footer or footnote the range is in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body. *startIndex* - REQUIRED. The zero-based start index of this range, in UTF-16 code units. In all current uses, a start index must be provided. This field is an Int32Value in order to accommodate future use cases with open-ended ranges. *endIndex* - REQUIRED. The zero-based end index of this range, exclusive, in UTF-16 code units. In all current uses, an end index must be provided. This field is an Int32Value in order to accommodate future use cases with open-ended ranges. *tabId* - The tab that contains this range. When omitted, the request applies to the first tab. In a document containing a single tab: - If provided, must match the singular tab's ID. - If omitted, the request applies to the singular tab. In a document containing multiple tabs: - If provided, the request applies to the specified tab. - If omitted, the request applies to the first tab in the document. IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"segmentId": "", "startIndex": 1, "endIndex": 10, "tabId": "tab1"}'</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eaa13f8b1c3b08db4a05930f1fcc3ed8f">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e8215add7ff162c8f6430211d9bc745ae"><em>Delete the text from index 15 to 35 in my document.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e04b06f5a37c30e66b82480ac911214b2"><em>Remove the content range from document xyz123 between indices 100 and 150.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e55858b864209c046153d355e172be238"><em>Clear the text spanning from character 0 to 50 in document abc456.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_insert_text</code> – Insert text at the specified location in the document.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1d6f29e77c69eaa9db2b582c82342fe0">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8ad32307c2c87a12b19df1451dd5d16a">Inject new text or paragraph content at a precise location.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee8829e686f45ad4201ebe3def040c97b">Populate table cells sequentially using their parsed paragraph start instructions.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e166734507a0e773cacaef9c604bc8fbc">Add a new sentence to the end of a specific section in the document structure.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8ad46e83b881cddce8220db78a35e937">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ee099ae43acb74781ab8386c1bf8a7408">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e841e120221dcc0d672c0fdb5fc01b489">
<code>text</code> – The text to insert</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eeebb372269ad114c7d8fd01825ca1569">(Optional) <code>endOfSegmentLocation</code> – Insert at the end of a segment (object with segmentId, tabId properties). Object structure: {"segmentId": string, "tabId": string}. IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"segmentId": "", "tabId": "tab1"}'</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed603fd80018bb559cfe85bd98f06ea69">(Optional) <code>location</code> – The specific location in the document (object with segmentId, index, tabId properties). CRITICAL: DO NOT use index 0. Determine paragraph start indices from google_docs_get_document first. IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"segmentId": "", "index": 1, "tabId": "tab1"}'</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e058903ad771f27f09f6d53da1c77fba9">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e340fcef5ec38d2f1c900da8ac7811c2d"><em>Insert the text "Overview of Strategy" at index 50 in document xyz123.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eaf9859ec2fee63c8efa880abcc3ce6e2"><em>Append the sentence "Conclusion reached." at the end of the document segment.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e73f3937c35a7b6e36fdb2c7127452999"><em>Write "Q4 Revenue" into the targeted cell's paragraph index for doc abc456.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_replace_all_text</code> – Replace all instances of specified text in the document.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e31d022b77a43f09e68ad383fefc51f13">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ee8dd03c7f4ecef19be7647c3d1d5a04b">Perform a massive find-and-replace command like renaming a project title.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e22bc4721eb9ead704a4ccca2aa8f8a79">Alter placeholder bracket variables systematically (for example, replace {{Name}} with John).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e007c8baa2d3dcdf43a0adec6fb4c3f97">Clean up a document by swapping outdated terms with fresh equivalents entirely.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e46efac580ff816016a844dbef9b3e87c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb6825b61ec89f3449d74e5195228aafb">
<code>containsText</code> – Finds text in the document matching this substring. A criteria that matches a specific string of text in the document. JSON representation: {"text": string, "matchCase": boolean,"searchByRegex": boolean}. IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"text": "search term", "matchCase": false, "searchByRegex": false}'</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e643022adca87483aa07a8d3ee1ad76a6">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e53786c49d7a520e8c9e34d1992cf7192">
<code>replaceText</code> – The text that will replace the matched text</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eeb5e959b7e6246bf74afb61229b8d11d">(Optional) <code>tabsCriteria</code> – Optional. The criteria used to specify which tab(s) the range deletion should occur in. Object structure: {"tabIds": string[]}. IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"tabIds": ["tab1", "tab2"]}'</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e20abd68a4d98f0554c28e0cbc69075c3">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eba84369638ea7d293fdcfb3df51d9a68"><em>Find and replace all instances of "Acme Corp" with "Initech" in document xyz123.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edd7907210efa3ff31d423f2558c6dca1"><em>Search for the regex string for dates and replace them globally with "TBD".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e41dd66188593b6ab59b68b86fca683a5"><em>Change every case-insensitive mention of "Project Red" to "Project Blue".</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h4 id="h_01KQFZ8TD27W2KT5F992D1R82Q">Advanced</h4><details><summary><code>google_docs_create_paragraph_bullets</code> – Create bullets for paragraphs in the specified range.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e3c45873ab97e11146249c275da74fa9c">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e74d7c520976b26c9638a6304e81fa673">Convert standard paragraphs into a bulleted list.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e17a6d332babdaeb126166f81fd08be19">Format a range of text into an ordered or unordered list.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3c7b1dc5065c9521cd2fae3379bbecab">Apply specific bullet numbering schemas to selected text.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e579430675182333d96949414249ab165">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e7e02b544feb2e5cd155f5da1f328ed04">
<code>bulletPreset</code> – The bullet glyph preset (for example, <code>BULLET_DISC_CIRCLE_SQUARE</code> or <code>NUMBERED_DECIMAL_ALPHA_ROMAN</code>).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed32369131740deceb89a32c677236264">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecbf456e755fbe8a7cba5c5b07c77642f">
<code>range</code> – The range of content to delete. Deleting text that crosses a paragraph boundary may result in changes to paragraph styles, lists, positioned objects and bookmarks as the two paragraphs are merged. Attempting to delete certain ranges can result in an invalid document structure in which case a <code>400 bad request</code> error is returned.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e208618f04755e724840797ddee3bd46f">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e8aad94c95f7398ca5febb3a6727c9c0c"><em>Add bullet points to the text in document xyz123 between index 50 and 100.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e49a344270b0ba04f3151844c14a6fe40"><em>Convert the paragraphs from index 10 to 30 into a numbered list in document abc456.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7e0f959a1862b43bbc54cc1767e83b0b"><em>Apply the BULLET_DISC_CIRCLE_SQUARE format to the chosen range in my project doc.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_delete_paragraph_bullets</code> – Delete bullets from paragraphs in the specified range.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e672f24e4407962261117262fa6df3667">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb57f86d719f54f863b4dce7d07e638eb">Remove list formatting from a specific set of paragraphs.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea5e91f8651c844ab862570681a1ad325">Convert a bulleted or numbered list back into plain text paragraphs.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3a2fb519714f2a39f854ec545b3775e6">Clear list styling from copied and pasted content without deleting the text.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eef2df7c4a057fab28f2cd3c765c24448">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e6c7714fc4aaea146a6ec33dda2842689">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e56c74522ce42225d014ab15dd8287fb5">
<code>range</code> – The range of content to delete. Deleting text that crosses a paragraph boundary may result in changes to paragraph styles, lists, positioned objects and bookmarks as the two paragraphs are merged. Attempting to delete certain ranges can result in an invalid document structure in which case a <code>400 bad request </code>error is returned.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_delete_positioned_object</code> – Delete a positioned object from the document.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e176876f2fdab8c29a5fe21b72e3194c3">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="efb1980d85df3cd1025dbb871751c8475">Remove a floating image or positioned graphic from a document.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0ffb9a08ec2dba43904a2523990046cc">Delete an incorrectly placed diagram or chart overlay.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e44a3fe9f961e9220a01f6e10e4791914">Programmatically clear positional layout objects for document cleanup.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e54c15fad42b699cf27b71eb3b5ced197">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e4491fc67fe51c64a8c7c68017193d908">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9a86b1980ed973bfe5c30e2e5b1bf592">
<code>objectId</code> – The ID of the positioned object to delete.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5afb0ed2922926af37cc4376fcd5f658">(Optional) <code>tabId</code> – The tab containing the object to delete.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ec53d3745bab38fd583a66b5f5a045462">

<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eef44b2432aee30e7db27ac652c0f5c27">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ebb226a01969e648322cde01966b0ab02">Mass update the formatting of a specific word or phrase throughout a document.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e71b115d14f5e053a50ae9e002b4f23a7">Turn all instances of a brand name to bold text.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3b9c16401f2501bdac112461a5eb45c2">Highlight or color-code specific key terms within notes.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5c95da10120a1161c1a2a7d4d54848f0">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e0d5731e378bdb1cb18df352a9b880540">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e925ab405027b100df084999ec8a1cca5">
<code>fields</code> – Comma-separated list of fields to update (for example, <code>bold,foregroundColor</code>). This must match the properties you set in <code>textStyle</code>. Examples:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3b8240aba132125d502afe01bff4c82d">
<strong>For bold only</strong> – <code>bold</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edca7ac41c405f74f68340e8cd6a3ee6c">
<strong>For bold and red</strong> – <code>bold,foregroundColor</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef884dc3c7a99ea637e4dc9a1a42f0bf4">
<strong>For italic and underline</strong> – <code>italic,underline</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee13c0fe81ed04d58fdafd048ba771d70">
<strong>For font size</strong> – <code>fontSize</code>.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e56a243e2fd21f95ff362a7bda5ce1239">
<code>findText</code> – The exact text to search for and update</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e111263c4cd91fba06b2cc5d3b0ae525d">
<code>textStyle</code> – The text style to apply to all found occurrences (JSON string). This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example for bold red text:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e95cec16f0bd4c77291b4a83f75e32e03"><pre class="language-json">{
  "bold": true,
  "foregroundColor": {
    "color": {
      "rgbColor": {
        "red": 1.0,
        "green": 0.0,
        "blue": 0.0
      }
    }
  }
}</pre></li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec9e5f252735b578994e19bf205ec199c">Common styles:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e909809a6bb96c63a52fbb65fe26b2732">
<strong>Bold</strong> – <code>{"bold": true}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8037008d5be8bb5654de3e159ec0e24d">
<strong>Italic</strong> – <code>{"italic": true}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2124c7a195429d2b8413c652010a5f91">
<strong>Underline</strong> – <code>{"underline": true}</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e685ad28c72b408de733da9eaff81873a">
<strong>Red text</strong> –</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e523665ecdaa39b15bfd7609c7430c4dd"><pre class="language-json">{
"foregroundColor": {
  "color": {
    "rgbColor": {
      "red": 1.0, 
      "green": 0.0, 
      "blue": 0.0
      }
    }
  }
}</pre></li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1a28709d5329f6b6615c828ada83d7cd">
<strong>Font size 14pt</strong> – <code>{"fontSize": {"magnitude": 14, "unit": "PT"}}</code>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e89bfd797dbe16f293487d2c1f276a75a">(Optional) <code>matchCase</code> – Whether the search should be case-sensitive (default: <code>false</code>)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea9781255de0b9da48cc551bdcd0fbbc0">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e27c7b7182a6538d5abe02b5eb7a231a4"><em>Find all instances of the word "TODO" and make them bold and red in document abc123.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5771f2e3a2deb2a34761c1634dc05544"><em>Make the phrase "Important Note" italicized everywhere it appears in the text.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e0265e0f0a613a10ceb024fffd50488fc"><em>Change the font size of "Google Docs" to 14pt throughout my proposal document.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_insert_inline_image</code> – Insert an inline image at the specified location.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebe18ebdf213ebb06c5f998cb15e7ae4d">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb0574427b14cfd4014e8d57080a54cc5">Add a logo or graphic into the flow of text in a document.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e04e67d91d978a5863bb0a2abc973ac5c">Attach an image directly to the end of a section automatically.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eebd97d6142c6b2c411200a1d1288f057">Insert a diagram into a report using a known image URI.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e324763ea8270dfc5c4af9f0cb52985aa">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e225c95ad8a12d5d63c3c5b0d9c2f87d5">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2d2bfe4d92b9152601b119fd2121e5a3">
<code>uri</code> – The URI of the image to insert</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2defe3b099e9469a7ae098d83fd98628">(Optional) <code>endOfSegmentLocation</code> – Insert at the end of a segment (object with segmentId, tabId properties). Object structure: {"segmentId": string, "tabId": string} *segmentId* - The ID of the header, footer or footnote. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body. *tabId* - The tab that the location is in. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab. In a document containing a single tab: - If provided, must match the singular tab's ID. - If omitted, the request applies to the singular tab. In a document containing multiple tabs: - If provided, the request applies to the specified tab. - If omitted, the request applies to the first tab in the document. (Union field: provide either location OR endOfSegmentLocation, not both) IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"segmentId": "", "tabId": "tab1"}'</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edaf360960201bdab13df3e35180d0184">(Optional) <code>location</code> – The specific location in the document (object with segmentId, index, tabId properties) IMPORTANT: Text must be inserted inside the bounds of an existing Paragraph. For instance, text cannot be inserted at a table's start index (i.e. between the table and its preceding paragraph). The text must be inserted in the preceding paragraph. CRITICAL: If you want to insert at the beginning of the document, DO NOT use index 0. Instead: 1. First call the 'google_docs_get_document' tool to retrieve the document structure 2. Find the first paragraph element in the document body 3. Use that paragraph's startIndex as your insertion point. Object structure: {"segmentId": string, "index": number, "tabId": string} *segmentId* - The ID of the header, footer or footnote the location is in. An empty segment ID signifies the document's body. *index* - REQUIRED. The zero-based index, in UTF-16 code units. The index is relative to the beginning of the segment specified by segmentId. WARNING: Index 0 is typically invalid for insertion - use document retrieval to find valid positions. *tabId* - The tab that the location is in. When omitted, the request is applied to the first tab. In a document containing a single tab: - If provided, must match the singular tab's ID. - If omitted, the request applies to the singular tab. In a document containing multiple tabs: - If provided, the request applies to the specified tab. - If omitted, the request applies to the first tab in the document. (Union field: provide either location OR endOfSegmentLocation, not both) IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"segmentId": "", "index": 1, "tabId": "tab1"}'</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e21c6abbbdae72ac47277a6ab265e1766">(Optional) <code>objectSize</code> – The size of an object in the document (object with width/height dimensions). Object structure: { "height": object (Dimension), "width": object (Dimension) } *height* - The height of the object *width* - The width of the object Each Dimension object has the structure: { "magnitude": number, "unit": enum (Unit) } Where Unit can be: UNIT_UNSPECIFIED, PT (points), INCH, MM (millimeters) IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"height": {"magnitude": 100, "unit": "PT"}, "width": {"magnitude": 100, "unit": "PT"}}'</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="edb7d195924cd71cbef7bc53924855769">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e06c62f8efc338daffed9142d4b52521d"><em>Insert the image from url "https://example.com/logo.png" at the end of document abc123.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e990cc2a9b38db230b77e033a55dc14c0"><em>Place an inline image at index 50 in document xyz789.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed4de06db0d19c495e193debe97cc301c"><em>Add an image sized 100pt by 100pt to the current document at the specified index.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_insert_table</code> – Insert a table at the specified location.</summary><div><ul>

</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_insert_table_column</code> – Insert a column into a table.</summary><div><ul>

<li data-list-item-id="e2753ae47640e4358e3d0af0e743fad81">Place a new line of data directly below or above a specific record in a grid.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3a4248cbe8b14e201177c262bdbdbe1b">Extend the capacity of a template table in a working Google Doc.</li>

<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed51b99d8e87d27cc00217ea45d2e48db">

</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_merge_table_cells</code> – Merge cells in a table.</summary><div><ul>

IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"tableCellLocation": {"tableStartLocation": {"index": 1}, "rowIndex": 0, "columnIndex": 0}, "rowSpan": 2, "columnSpan": 2}'</li>

<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="edcdd16e63da55bad03cfbf16ff98e148">

</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_replace_image</code> – Replace an existing image with a new image.</summary><div><ul>

<li data-list-item-id="e38d53f1566e82731cb582982c8dd5cd3">Replace an incorrect branding logo with the updated URI reference.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e23a1eff5ef12cabd1cd4a79baa485dc3">Automatically update report visuals preserving the exact image aspect bounds.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e18881329c3672aebd638cde1de38c3b8">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3fb6f7528497f0a99af53692f9fb1dbb">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e352ea89129ad9cda1e3e0b37664a001f">
<code>imageObjectId</code> – The ID of the existing image to replace</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e354a60f126998265770403bf3092eec9">
<code>uri</code> – The URI of the new image</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e793fe5b381befea9394f066c4bb1bc8f">(Optional) <code>imageReplaceMethod</code> – The replacement method (CENTER_CROP)</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efbcfee45cb9986db54b5253d30dbe1e9">(Optional) <code>tabId</code> – The tab containing the image to replace</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e616e1ab7867dcbaf869a4e60934a32c7">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5b9a41bac213b26b5a7c8a83eff41974"><em>Replace the image "img-xyz" with the new URL "https://example.com/new_logo.png" in doc abc123.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e53962fe26496c4a62c0241c31aaa1274"><em>Swap the outdated chart graphic object ID "chart01" with the live update URI.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e486d92a3031adec0bce64a8b87bf4d67"><em>Replace the target graphic using the CENTER_CROP replacement method.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_unmerge_table_cells</code> – Unmerge previously merged cells in a table.</summary><div><ul>

<li data-list-item-id="ea219dd1c1032180bb9969a1acd4e6c49">Restore a customized table header mapping back to independent grid cells.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee7f4b28df6c946659938a2c368ae7f08">Disconnect elements accidentally spanning additional rows incorrectly.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e78baa82de7d8fce1649dadd8b48c07bb">Reformat previously condensed template grids to accept individual granular values.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8e53cad0b14617267bc5689192741621">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e12bf5dff3e9074dae46c6805c6c78873">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efb0e801d5de6b619ebed725e93e7c6c9">
<code>tableRange</code> – The table range to affect (object with tableCellLocation, rowSpan, columnSpan properties). Object structure: {"tableCellLocation": TableCellLocation, "rowSpan": number, "columnSpan": number}. IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"tableCellLocation": {"tableStartLocation": {"index": 1}, "rowIndex": 0, "columnIndex": 0}, "rowSpan": 2, "columnSpan": 2}'</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef955101f5acdd909698beeefe8eafe1d">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edc7874f2577192252f5ad1f96656414f"><em>Unmerge the previously combined 3-column cell starting at index 20.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e278929b2beba4950cf17fbca5c2f3e0a"><em>Disconnect the spanned cell structure encompassing row 1 and 2 in document abc123.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea865960abe3911e4db611232ad6a20ea"><em>Restore the individual cell columns of the designated table location back to default format.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_update_paragraph_style</code> – Update paragraph style in the specified range.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea78c18c4199e0499688e2c9f17ca3309">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e39d33cc9c4bd6147d1deadda6b8ffb5a">Alter line spacing, borders, or text direction rules for a selected paragraph.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e49648c9778f80e793799e478db2c533b">Convert specific text fragments accurately spanning exact indices to header formats.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef2a190af316798c7904c3ff8d223e999">Align document text (for example, center standard paragraphs or right-align footers).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ec22706fe4f0c79fb0db1464b940fc9e9">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eccc9484414f50c09fde7d0d962cca101">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6c746ff690329811f693add4ad9f22d4">
<code>fields</code> – The fields to update (comma-separated list or "*" for all fields). Uses Google Protobuf FieldMask format - specify nested object fields with dot notation (for example, "bold,fontSize.magnitude,backgroundColor.color.rgbColor"). Use "*" to update all fields, or specify individual fields to update only those properties.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e766c3ae19e4173559b324f77b0b8d044">
<code>paragraphStyle</code> – Paragraph styling properties that apply to a whole paragraph (object with style properties). Object structure includes headingId, namedStyleType, alignment, lineSpacing, direction, spaceAbove, indentFirstLine, etc. IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"alignment": "CENTER", "lineSpacing": 150}'</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e74065d0edcfe9ef7ed07049eb988019c">
<code>range</code> – The range of content to affect (object with segmentId, startIndex, endIndex, tabId properties). IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"segmentId": "", "startIndex": 1, "endIndex": 10, "tabId": "tab1"}'</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5f39fbbb154f32db03341369648b602a">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef9b477bd57b27758edadef1916271de9"><em>Center align the paragraph stretching from index 50 to 100 in document xyz123.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e329890210fc9713d3528936e55a3c746"><em>Increase the lineSpacing format property for the chosen paragraph range.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7c7a390d897a92e73f39bb24b0db2783"><em>Assign the "HEADING_1" namedStyleType style to the target selection block.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_update_table_column_properties</code> – Update properties of columns in a table such as width.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e198aec2f990dff68555bca07aae0cb81">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e6a26adcd69b97cff894a96c2c29fa6ad">Hardcode specific point widths (PT) to specific column indices in report tables.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e34a5bf14e7f9c24d2e5eb311b20d534c">Evenly distribute column width distributions seamlessly.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef744f0bf235df80d097419d940d1819c">Restructure visual aesthetics when table columns look disproportionate.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed35a0af85c9713bdfd63065c5254a0ae">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e6a384463e660c71b0290956dc11a50f4">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efe8fc31da71061d40f0ff9235416eb25">
<code>fields</code> – The fields to update (comma-separated list or "*" for all fields). Uses Google Protobuf FieldMask format.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef7a3dfabf747cfada507ead570d9e0e1">
<code>tableColumnProperties</code> – Table column properties that control the width and other characteristics of a table column (object with properties). Object structure: { "width": object (Dimension), "widthType": enum (WidthType) }. IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"widthType": "FIXED_WIDTH", "width": {"magnitude": 100, "unit": "PT"}}'</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e23afa08e419df39ce1b31d93f468b667">
<code>tableStartLocation</code> – The specific location in the document (object with segmentId, index, tabId properties). IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"segmentId": "", "index": 1, "tabId": "tab1"}'</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e20651333c56892bf4418291d380488da">(Optional) <code>columnIndices</code> – Optional column indices to update as a comma-separated string or JSON array string. Examples: "0,1,2" or "[0,1,2]" or single value "0"</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6361e78a7019c2a2ea133f4105c1b174">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e64d10a1c63734ef6c2110b9b330d03b3"><em>Set the width of column 1 in the target table to 150 PT using document abc123.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e9663bf0f4d5afab18e526d42d7a04aeb"><em>Distribute columns roughly adjusting the width property for referenced indices.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eeda6b445eb65a87da9b4be50bd9058ac"><em>Update table column properties to evenly distribute width spacing.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_docs_update_text_style</code> – Update the text style in the specified range.</summary><div><ul>
