<li data-list-item-id="eba65ba03f5bd51f7d676141294e193da">Bold, italicize, or highlight particular sentences inside exact boundary coordinates.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e805c6f67574eb9903cd82eb231806b88">Apply specific font size magnitudes to text ranges directly.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb94064cdc420049428cabad539e3cfc5">Overwrite default document colors to RGB hex configurations on specific characters.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e628e8a76fb9048eda91d40c1aa6c0846">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e51460b85686c0b0bfacb1dc64135fb76">
<code>documentId</code> – The ID of the document to update</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e652b1dcb8c98bb91f33fd7c662fd862c">
<code>fields</code> – The fields to update (comma-separated list or "*" for all fields). Uses Google Protobuf FieldMask format - specify nested object fields with dot notation (for example, "bold,fontSize.magnitude,backgroundColor.color.rgbColor"). Use "*" to update all fields, or specify individual fields to update only those properties.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e04aa2da1b2682e43dda664813c0af1ef">
<code>range</code> – The range of content to affect (object with segmentId, startIndex, endIndex, tabId properties). IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"segmentId": "", "startIndex": 1, "endIndex": 10, "tabId": "tab1"}'</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef659a37e24620ae815890fce5db28e87">
<code>textStyle</code> – Text styling properties that can be applied to text content (object with style properties). Object structure supports bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, smallCaps, backgroundColor, foregroundColor, fontSize, weightedFontFamily, baselineOffset, link. IMPORTANT: This parameter must be provided as a JSON string. Example: '{"bold": true, "fontSize": {"magnitude": 12, "unit": "PT"}}'</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eeabe8b98ddce14c2ae6dc42d8e609401">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e97aa0eae3ca7dbf3d855e7223177ed39"><em>Make the text spanning index 20 to 45 bold and italicized in document xyz123.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee98018c901837670b158ada6488f9a0b"><em>Apply a font size of 16pt and red foregroundColor to the chosen range string.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e94dc1e9ab01d575cb11ebbc0569797fd"><em>Strip all formatting fields across paragraph parameters updating the raw textStyle.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h3 id="h_01KQD2GWE8S4PKH0RKP0MP3X3H">Google Sheets<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KQD2GWE8S4PKH0RKP0MP3X3H"></a></h3><p>The Google Sheets tools let you create, read, update, and format spreadsheet data directly from Opal. Use them to log data, analyze ranges, manage sheets, and automate spreadsheet tasks without leaving your current workflow.</p><h4 id="h_01KQFZ9RVWEXS3MPZ0R2WVT9G1">Read</h4><details><summary><code>google_sheets_get_spreadsheet</code> – Retrieves detailed information about a specific Google Sheets spreadsheet.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ecddbd697597077e68d2dcad074535ce4">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ee96f1765be7f5e239a76cd1ab01bed5f">Get the URL or link to a spreadsheet.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1d6f9c86c64c645d94bf027534c20abe">View spreadsheet structure and sheets.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2ad4b4dffbcacfc5bea9051d3ed75c00">Retrieve spreadsheet metadata.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea31c63066cf65e124ced709ec5f5308d">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul><li data-list-item-id="eb0d816e8a618f93e6347b797006314fc">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet to retrieve.</li></ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e9340296abfaf4560821d7af8d003aa9f">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e8b299c963a7f3e49b23ca20eef5b08d3"><em>Get the details and URL for spreadsheet xyz.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e48b175ccdf65f7b0d725f82652536af2"><em>Find out how many sheets are in this spreadsheet.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edc2f453b57975153c7fedd2319a3dd33"><em>Check the metadata and locale of my spreadsheet.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_list_spreadsheets</code> – Lists the Google Sheets spreadsheets in your Google Drive.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e5829efb9e35c139bd1a3b6564c9bde68">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5f716f102c0ac9e3b7d743ee1869aec0">Find spreadsheets by name or title.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebf652990c482c8c2ceb57f1c80a27cc1">Browse available spreadsheets.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec6429483bc9202bfd7f6eca89d2a3dd5">Find recently modified spreadsheets.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eef147024367f51e852fcf28b8099a9ab">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e9d20c892400a84af6d3a5eccc85a793f">(Optional) <code>includeTrashed</code> – Whether to include trashed and deleted spreadsheets in results. Default: <code>false</code> (excludes trashed spreadsheets). Set to <code>true</code> to include spreadsheets in trash.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e26cdc286046fcf976e1dbd5754eab531">(Optional) <code>maxResults</code> – Maximum number of spreadsheets to return per page. Default: 10. Examples:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec5a989cc89405020b265b02048336b4c">10 – Default.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edf728c353385180333265ae46b9e1515">50 – For larger lists.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3294045665eed94cc172208578d13238">100 – Maximum recommended.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e324499c4ef06a7426b63f5f3986b76fc">(Optional) <code>pageToken</code> – Token for retrieving the next page of results.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0d3450ed22ce85bac3e1fe284d9f80f0">(Optional) <code>query</code> – Search query to filter spreadsheets by name. Matching is case-insensitive and partial.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e123d6d93ef488a44cb3cc9808253eae1">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea08d9b30aca851f0df030949b2803851"><em>List all spreadsheets modified recently.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e68e4e336afd22c046f69e6bc3ea7d0a7"><em>Search for spreadsheets named "Budget".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee82b4909c924283a9f3d8ad510708d23"><em>Show me my latest 10 Google Sheets.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_read_values</code> – Reads values from a specified range in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee665e6bee4462588e1e2bf1fe7e2190d">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef88c910769dec032e2fb844034ef23f2">Read data from specific cells or ranges.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1f1fa276c4c8ddb3202f136a10821b3a">Extract table data for analysis.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec50e15b9cfaea30d798a31aa1817072f">Get lookup tables or reference lists.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ea44c4b448ccce06b301ad4456304813b">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eaf28f781675c14707889bf5d6f8dec7f">
<code>range</code> – The A1 notation of the range to read. Common patterns:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e06068e260a96ee5e24164019161b294c">
<strong>Single cell</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A1</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef33de8eb0a7a0567c89427f4ad9d9a25">
<strong>Rectangular range</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A1:D10</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e45f3ed8e47a32dbff8c6703f2d8d219a">
<strong>Entire row</strong> – <code>Sheet1!5:5</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec2d2f4e12dcf7fb632e979712caeac02">
<strong>Entire column </strong>– <code>Sheet1!A:A</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea6c8720c8bb4772e36f0397f9c2018c6">
<strong>Multiple columns</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A:C</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e97182a88b4fbf2b61be4f683a83ff62c">
<strong>Named range</strong> – <code>MyNamedRange</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e059030b431bbe236f26b4368eb8aeff8">
<strong>Default sheet</strong> – <code>A1:D10</code> (uses first sheet)</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb3850de496aed07a2f1b7afceaea85e1">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet to read from.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7550ce2bb37fa0ec6a5ede5f259f4a48">(Optional) <code>dateTimeRenderOption</code> – How dates should be represented. Options:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e2e90fb9ac236a989355bc7e86bbf7840">
<code>FORMATTED_STRING</code> – (Default) Returns formatted date text (for example, "11/15/2024").</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8fe6b09f1c43f57a06dd7cee1a8272b8">
<code>SERIAL_NUMBER</code> – Returns numeric date value (for example, 45249).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e53afc87a9029b87dcb804f3595efcd5d">(Optional) <code>valueRenderOption</code> – How values should be represented. Options:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e14453a3ad07a5b634d1e568f2ed7b0b0">
<code>FORMATTED_VALUE</code> – (Default) Returns formatted text as displayed in the UI.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e515220813fbfa1b5c32930e1aa872840">
<code>UNFORMATTED_VALUE</code> – Returns underlying values (for example, numbers without currency formatting).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9782ca95da9ce74be18ba1acbbcf187b">
<code>FORMULA</code> – Returns formulas as text (for example, <code>=SUM(A1:A10)</code>).</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1516733f3302287fe9848891f6f02646">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e5a880cec7d1b51a99fa27bb75558205b"><em>Read the values from Sheet1!A1:C10.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e0b720ffc4a8d133efde0259d193a009f"><em>Extract the data from the first 5 rows.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e360bf3bdd4b482c529325ab89309c32c"><em>Get the contents of the D column.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h4 id="h_01KQFZ9VS0AYAGF8FKRZ3MQMJA">Write</h4><details><summary><code>google_sheets_append_values</code> – Appends new rows of data to the end of a table in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eaa9099d1f09782e1b67545dfc19f5e1a">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e4bffbecb5d024c523a0716d2e1e93d76">Add new records to a table or list.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e40663f28b45340254a56332f5f04a43f">Log new entries such as events and transactions.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e445d5a9faf396e561d289cbd7d737a9e">Append form responses or survey data.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ec0dd5697f667e1d9cb0e92f890c3ef1a">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ea2220578da07eab20a578693e045957d">
<code>range</code> – The A1 notation range to append to. Use column range for best results. Common patterns:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e247f253767ca6571fbe36a4f0d421f51">
<strong>All columns</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A:D</code> (appends to columns A through D).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1aec8dee6810d5fef9df9ee9ae31b66d">
<strong>Full sheet</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A:Z</code> (appends across many columns).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eda1daf3df68977a28d839fd39074aaa0">
<strong>Specific columns</strong> – <code>Sheet1!B:E</code> (appends to columns B through E).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e90e23696d885d147cb9f24e8e131a28e">
<strong>Named range</strong> – <code>DataTable</code> (appends to named range).<br><br>Use column ranges (<code>A:D</code>) instead of cell ranges (<code>A1:D100</code>).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecd990ebc177f5b8ad762b2e2dc5132c0">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet to append to.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed78603a701b2fe7ba7ac9238739ea40c">
<code>values</code> – Pipe-delimited values where rows are separated by newlines (<code>\n</code>) and columns by pipes (<code>|</code>). Each row should have the same number of columns as your table. Use empty value between pipes for empty cells.<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e13da03252ed6f6c15500cf9b4ec92405">
<strong>Single row</strong> – <code>John [Doe|john@example.com](mailto:Doe|john@example.com)|Active</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4bf605815c02e1526d10297b67cfde76">
<strong>Two rows</strong> – <code>John [Doe|john@example.com](mailto:Doe|john@example.com)|Active\nJane [Smith|jane@example.com](mailto:Smith|jane@example.com)|Pending</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5283e32110cb8d62c888f86657c20ee2">
<strong>With date and status (three rows)</strong> – <code>[John|john@example.com](mailto:John|john@example.com)|[2024-11-12|Active\nJane|jane@example.com](mailto:2024-11-12|Active\nJane|jane@example.com)|[2024-11-12|Pending\nBob|bob@example.com](mailto:2024-11-12|Pending\nBob|bob@example.com)|2024-11-13|Active</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7fb2a18a5637d6c2c3ac7d1f47bc568f">
<strong>With empty cells</strong> – <code>[Alice||alice@example.com](mailto:Alice||alice@example.com)\[nBob|Smith|bob@example.com](mailto:nBob|Smith|bob@example.com)</code> (Alice has no last name).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5881fdec7d679b0c97296b05240f178e">(Optional) <code>insertDataOption</code> – How data should be inserted. Options:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ea18e976df8957f678620889b3cbe0264">
<code>INSERT_ROWS</code> (default) – Adds new rows after existing data.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef4f82997e21c418ca4531d9ff842aba5">
<code>OVERWRITE</code> – Overwrites cells starting at append position.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7475eed17b48ec8fedd4ddf6a1dfc6bc">(Optional) <code>valueInputOption</code> – How input data should be interpreted. Options:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ebece8f9035859ef5e84b666b3e3175d2">
<code>USER_ENTERED</code> (default) – Parses input, such as formulas, numbers, and dates.<ul><li data-list-item-id="e91eba94c460b4ffb32bfd5941f3f7256">"2024-11-12" becomes a date, "100" becomes number 100.</li></ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ead4aa1b3bc68b96896e1daba9e8fb29b">
<code>RAW</code> – Stores as-is. Everything becomes text.<ul><li data-list-item-id="ef2f7946b73413f9cba0f3af00149b39f">"2024-11-12" stays as text, "100" becomes text "100".</li></ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2587b7990a0e3e730d8b6c1fb4952ba1">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eca6c64726737ed8e125e78aa402ef179"><em>Append the row "John [Doe|john@example.com](mailto:Doe|john@example.com)" to Sheet1!A:B.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e83c6204cafdd3b8a64d1213007f9df2e"><em>Log a new transaction at the end of the ledger table.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4b359489b0f6389314702ed3f311e760"><em>Add these three new customer records to the end of my sheet.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_clear_values</code> – Clears all values from a specified range in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee4a60e26d66da2a425b6107150e1870f">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ea0e8d99bcf2f02fa3c9d3088c09e9de6">Reset a data range to empty.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5adce14a1353555d9267180f1176ea99">Clear old entries before adding new data.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6b4670580af7e9d322d6514787f972b2">Remove temporary calculation results.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e0cf0aa00cd02726c406eba78cea541a2">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="edf81081139a3e0787c1e7a0555b5bf8a">
<code>range</code> – The A1 notation of the range to clear. Common patterns:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e151042212325c4cdbb67e077caa107a2">
<strong>Specific range</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A1:D10</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed2aa03f7dc7a7e42ba385a873aea8ff3">
<strong>Entire row</strong> – <code>Sheet1!5:5</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed26a85c7f03e59a4da407db92fb79cf4">
<strong>Multiple rows</strong> – <code>Sheet1!2:5</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed38b3f4d9a197192596ae45ccd6ec1f7">
<strong>Entire column</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A:A</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5eb6d89d0d9c90a3bb0015cf7511e0c6">
<strong>Multiple columns</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A:C</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8cb0ec71b63a0be6c48511faf3d416ef">
<strong>Entire sheet</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A:Z</code> (adjust Z based on sheet width).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e24008184b2d7891e26bfb5344317069c">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet containing the range to clear.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2cb86d4a1df900caad9f719549d7c563">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e47a75d4cd21683ae85c0533b760a1362"><em>Clear all data in range A2:D10.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e2b689256c48725898242468b322a0793"><em>Erase the contents of row 5.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e596b21339d2f20d42677ab350b29f5ff"><em>Empty the values from column B.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_create_spreadsheet</code> – Creates a new Google Sheets spreadsheet with optional initial data.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef04f2c588825ad630cb59c28ecf14af0">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb62660f3d492bdf966c7d6ec0b29731e">Create new spreadsheets for tracking data.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef49f495d49f94c19b7194bd02edb7b7c">Configure data collection sheets.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e82f1ab27577efa70a68f38f7afff3a0f">Initialize spreadsheets with template data.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e218e2d398a1ee45875b36579e59b80ae">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e02c9fe171d4e1f8bd2c05858c9ef0f99">
<code>title</code> – Title for the new spreadsheet.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e39a04fd23f74c5bddd7e5e9c948f1053">(Optional) <code>initialData</code> – Initial data to populate the first sheet. Pipe-delimited format. First row typically contains headers. Use <code>\n</code> for row breaks and <code>|</code> for column breaks. Examples:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e212f99ad131bedd8b5387e74fc4c664e">
<strong>Simple table (3x3)</strong> – <code>[Name|Email|Status\nJohn|john@example.com](mailto:Name|Email|Status\nJohn|john@example.com)|[Active\nJane|jane@example.com](mailto:Active\nJane|jane@example.com)|Inactive</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee70dcb5c960efe991a8db074e105545e">
<strong>With headers only</strong> – <code>Product|Price|Quantity</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea80b301b2904ba6279b34b15b9b773cc">
<strong>Coupon codes table</strong> – <code>Code|Discount|Valid Until\nSAVE10|10%|2024-12-31\nWELCOME20|20%|2024-11-30</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8428bec6c3fed324fc0f24b95c706f04">
<strong>With empty cells</strong> – <code>[Name|Phone|Email\nJohn||john@example.com](mailto:Name|Phone|Email\nJohn||john@example.com)\nJane|555-1234</code> (John has no phone, Jane has no email).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e749eb91534cdfe2a51f27c85da1bf30d">(Optional) <code>sheetTitle</code> – Title for the first sheet tab.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e0fa84c63667a31ecf7d75c10c65670ac">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7f9f1a60d73d2a46f2c8378ed21e369d"><em>Create a new spreadsheet called "2024 Q4 Budget".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e84566c2739fbd0884abb2149ab37f662"><em>Make a new Google Sheet named "Customer Contact List" with some initial header rows.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e877164e1cf5235bb3def6e56dcf98257"><em>Start a new project timeline spreadsheet.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_batch_update_values</code> – Updates multiple ranges in a Google Sheets spreadsheet in a single batch request.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e70ee1bae9e7273850ece77d3ff3d313c">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ea648eaaf86de594fba829c4af5173b15">Update multiple tables or sections at once.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7b39b4d07772d600ace88ebf86779884">Modify data across different sheets in a single operation.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e68f6aa6bd8611f456fbf273bb9b615bc">Bulk update scattered cells efficiently.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e375d79dc711bca6026f87180d3a4f717">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="edb98b9183395ef5fc5fe29487f358492">
<code>data</code> – Multiple range updates separated by double newlines. Format: <code>range::values</code> where values are pipe-delimited (<code>|</code>).<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec29ad626eae6a24a07d97295fb2de364">
<strong>Single range update</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A1:B2::[Name|Email\nJohn|john@example.com](mailto:Name|Email\nJohn|john@example.com)</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec4b8888e6e90bee4693fe770f3bfc0d0">
<strong>Two range updates (different sheets)</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A1:B2::[Name|Email\nJohn|john@example.com](mailto:Name|Email\nJohn|john@example.com)\n\nSheet2!A1:C1::Q1|Q2|Q3</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee03a56d11fb844aa822ac01785e92c13">
<strong>Three range updates</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A1::Status\n\nSheet1!B1:C1::100|200\n\nSheet2!A1:A3::Red\nGreen\nBlue</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecff8feaaa26a58ce1c1e3a24d1710e44">
<strong>Update header and data rows</strong> – <code>Sheet1!A1:C1::Name|Email|Status\n\nSheet1!A2:C3::[John|john@example.com](mailto:John|john@example.com)|[Active\nJane|jane@example.com](mailto:Active\nJane|jane@example.com)|Pending</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e86e767b2d7a8f18b3736a6dd017f8356">
<strong>Different sheets, different sizes </strong>– <code>Summary!A1::Total Sales\n\nData!A1:D2::Q1|Q2|Q3|Q4\n100|200|300|400</code>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eeb6836fdaf8bb1282939e8392c4fb0b9">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet to update.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0ad5cb244f920e35c35ea67920de5cd0">(Optional) <code>valueInputOption</code> – How input data should be interpreted. Options:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e9eda08261d8eb81bd550150f55f0929e">
<code>USER_ENTERED</code> (default) – Parses input, such as formulas, numbers, and dates.<ul><li data-list-item-id="e1797e3f293041429d860f472a69293e6">"2024-11-12" becomes a date, "100" becomes number 100.</li></ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e87587ae140ca94a18e7267c24e615ad1">
<code>RAW</code> – Stores as-is. Everything becomes text.<ul><li data-list-item-id="ea6c504529a18c9cec24c2ba95e8abe07">"2024-11-12" stays as text, "100" becomes text "100".</li></ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e7bb4b0d4815cff73a92e7e224dcbd48f">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e7296aec236e7f1c6c941e2afa633854b"><em>Update Sheet1 A1 with "Status" and Sheet2 B1 with "Active".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e97e53daad0d95dd7579b7b06aa416960"><em>Batch update the header row and the totals column at once.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee1d43710922b92b3ecb29cf9c185dd2b"><em>Modify Q1 and Q2 data across different tabs simultaneously.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h4 id="h_01KQFZ9Y75H6W7GH8AFKWP82MQ">Advanced</h4><details><summary><code>google_sheets_add_sheet</code> – Adds a new sheet (tab) to an existing Google Sheets spreadsheet.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e09b8da863812536c601e01f7194e65e9">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e80e29576fac47d31db472c78f6331e76">Add monthly or quarterly tabs (for example, "Q4 2024").</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ece2155e8a594016f0288f5a842c2ccfd">Create separate sheets for different categories or projects.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8bfbcb350cbb177956abe84b5a6312b9">Add summary or report sheets.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2556233685d17f1d4ffc794d87847d2d">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eff63b4de4c9c2f6abd4292abae88cdaa">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet to add a sheet to.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eadf27fe6034aecabd04e1fc9117f2205">
<code>title</code> – The title for the new sheet. Must be unique within the spreadsheet.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec3b0518c2a31b868b1e56e56c7e153bf">(Optional) <code>columnCount</code> – Number of columns in the new sheet (default: 26).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e856d04f2d2004f3acb74e7b7f5c757d8">(Optional) <code>rowCount</code> – Number of rows in the new sheet (default: 1000).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eb4822b88ae18507ed39c086f703b5915">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e03ba32c1d2529bf1bbca9cb8d358591f"><em>Add a new sheet named "Q4 2024" to my spreadsheet.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e27b8509abb33e57d577078949dc14ef5"><em>Create a "Summary" tab with 50 rows in my Google Sheet.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edf9a151504012a2d29af515879b7fd10"><em>Add another sheet to the current spreadsheet.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_append_columns</code> – Appends blank columns to the end of a Google Sheets sheet.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2031da74fe41f5093ccc8da5f85f01fb">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e34ac191996fae4767dbea905cf952bad">Expand a sheet to accommodate more data fields.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6705dd224b46aee89b9478d5221309b1">Add space at the end for future columns.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb47bce20544462bb265d6bcd944f198e">Increase sheet width capacity.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef83c450c9b1641c96726fb180150b5af">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e592a694d9d2614f05575cbad9111b60d">
<code>count</code> – The number of columns to append. Must be a positive integer.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e30fab6a2cf349cdbbb6324b88ae9d016">
<code>sheetId</code> – The numeric ID of the sheet where rows are appended. Use the <code>google_sheets_get_spreadsheet</code> tool to find the sheet ID. This is not the sheet name or title.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edcadab1705752e91fd28c7a0e5cf39b2">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e68eca567a44e94133b02ffe77953a390">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee39eb1b3f302d62dcc7e4dddde81d2b2"><em>Append five blank columns to the end of the sheet.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edc5422d13c0775b0a6d9db6c4a94efbc"><em>Add three columns to sheet ID 0 in my spreadsheet.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3c5dfe7b8737727bb9fed3d4d39a018b"><em>Give me 10 more columns at the end of the document.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_append_rows</code> – Appends blank rows to the end of a Google Sheets sheet.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2bde67a80ad356673022c7137e043ed0">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ecf4796be34d7a8d11cc82d92869bbb16">Expand a sheet to accommodate more data.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed2b8669fbb2329dd2eb27e230a6abc0a">Add space at the end for future entries.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="effdc44810ce6bc44782005241845b25e">Prepare a sheet for data import.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e554b88e2390c1253fc7159bf9fd20712">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e0b687e0d2c51218a1e04ffae91436da1">
<code>count</code> – The number of rows to append. Must be a positive integer.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3f355ffdbff7ad774afe6f41f6b52c5f">
<code>sheetId</code> – The numeric ID of the sheet where rows are appended. Use the <code>google_sheets_get_spreadsheet</code> tool to find the sheet ID. This is not the sheet name or title.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8f2075e697c1801240373da3432c8e35">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e20621100eedc1a27afc2f427ed5a6527">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e13ee044af8543e2e9d7562caced47dba"><em>Append 10 rows to the bottom of the sheet.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e96dfc009eec4ccf12bd4c4e3e11df0e2"><em>Add 100 blank rows to spreadsheet xyz.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef410e1686cfd457f0c28251567101857"><em>Give me 50 more rows at the end of the document.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_format_cells</code> – Format cells in a Google Sheets spreadsheet by applying background colors, text colors, or both.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8b25045de80b85327c26827063a7fd5c">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3027f01557ea23467a0dd963382287c2">Highlight header rows with distinct background colors.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb038bc8ba71c0ba1cd8e36c4fac7d58a">Color-code data by status.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e23b43cf6f8256cd40b61950b2a1e0321">Format entire rows or columns with consistent colors.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ec7579d0ca6d4d9000b2a9f3f4f4b5cfd">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e867eea1390b11f477579df07730bc7ea">
<code>endColumnIndex</code> – The ending column index (0-based, exclusive). Examples:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e1ff891909f44a8720e832031e01ec40a">
<strong>To format only column A</strong> – <code>endColumnIndex = 1</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4afd965635d2f49ce1b87253d83f5ef0">
<strong>To format columns A–E </strong>– <code>endColumnIndex = 5</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e93d066f93181e9fbc82a0449376f3db3">
<strong>To format columns A–Z</strong> – <code>endColumnIndex = 26</code>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9a4b1725392c135701d25f62521d7b61">
<code>endRowIndex</code> – The ending row index (0-based, exclusive). Examples:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec97710ae97ab0376827d1d33ac07e787">
<strong>To format only row 0</strong> – <code>endRowIndex = 1</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee63eb64d6eb3eefdd753ff1fb11d5ebb">
<strong>To format rows 0–4 (first 5 rows)</strong> – <code>endRowIndex = 5</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4c061129ef978dc424610c2119b9e6b5">
<strong>To format rows 0–9 (first 10 rows)</strong> – <code>endRowIndex = 10</code>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e170b7f461fd0d785830bfc9e09e44923">
<code>sheetId</code> – The numeric sheet ID (not the sheet name).</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1106237ed77d5af9b2b3841f6cc0df35">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet containing the cells to format.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eecc20199ada3f3246c30115c596c2c3a">
<code>startColumnIndex</code> – The starting column index (0-based, inclusive). Column Index Reference:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e5039827de85d2d07b2a9c502dd6f583b">
<strong>Column A</strong> – 0</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2c3b54ead3e4b9b465d375bdecc38757">
<strong>Column B </strong>– 1</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9f9d274c2ccb56380e4de6960bb8b4c6">
<strong>Column C</strong> – 2</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eeeb37dd45a680aceb7e06d6ba4223c79">
<strong>Column D </strong>– 3, and so on.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e061b27e29531cab6b100227d4ac3bf91">
<code>startRowIndex</code> – The starting row index (0-based, inclusive). Examples:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e784eb25beaaa5abbba995645a8f495b0">
<strong>First row</strong> – 0</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eca7a117114895b787c6e09331c2da88e">
<strong>Second row</strong> – 1</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6f5f0019159cd2dce918355c41874b18">
<strong>Tenth row</strong> – 9</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e371321390eb4dd5ab3f8638be3b093e9">(Optional) <code>backgroundColor</code> – Background color in RGB format: <code>red,green,blue</code> where each value is 0.0–1.0. Specify <code>backgroundColor</code>, <code>textColor</code>, or both. Example: <code>0.0,0.0,0.55</code>. Common colors:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e2fa78cfb9df99f2cb9a8b6abc7721ba8">
<strong>Red</strong> – <code>1.0,0.0,0.0</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e11d050e7ee05f1dfeeed741fae29de16">
<strong>Green</strong> – <code>0.0,1.0,0.0</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e672d062ebc0f053565310483eb8561df">
<strong>Blue</strong> – <code>0.0,0.0,1.0</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e36db19c5e3da09aab0b32d3174e9188c">
<strong>Yellow</strong> – <code>1.0,1.0,0.0</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1118719fde42cab6205cec9b2f6c46a1">
<strong>Orange</strong> – <code>1.0,0.65,0.0</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb7bfe8b53db5746043af38088f2a3029">
<strong>Light Blue</strong> – <code>0.68,0.85,0.90</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e84722ea8e0b8b138df180a8a344aba5d">
<strong>Light Gray</strong> – <code>0.85,0.85,0.85</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9bbab71cd4c7357bd835ab754d6a2805">
<strong>Dark Blue</strong> – <code>0.0,0.0,0.55</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea83c8889103140ac037b15490ea595a0">
<strong>White</strong> – <code>1.0,1.0,1.0</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e390865091504f438ebaf09f428fdd07f">
<strong>Black</strong> – <code>0.0,0.0,0.0</code>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e11a82dcbc561f36ec4ccd7f0bc4476a2">(Optional) <code>textColor</code> – Text and foreground color in RGB format: <code>red,green,blue</code> where each value is 0.0–1.0. Specify <code>backgroundColor</code>, <code>textColor</code>, or both. Example: <code>1.0,1.0,1.0</code>. Common colors:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ebee67886fda44441ede4be5fdceb48c2">
<strong>Black text</strong> – <code>0.0,0.0,0.0</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ede0664583ed535d8e09002dbcb3fe935">
<strong>White text</strong> – <code>1.0,1.0,1.0</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e87c1f073bdefc7760b4aadefc4a4ba50">Red text – <code>1.0,0.0,0.0</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e801ae78f86a227b607b51bff278438f5">Blue text – <code>0.0,0.0,1.0</code>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea95946a0b9ead5dd0ddc8db2f5bca1d0">Gray text – <code>0.5,0.5,0.5</code>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1f46e9168494949b2ba3ce078a4b9e7c">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ed44faef168bfa36b44d79db7b1d98342"><em>Make the background of the first row dark blue.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e57d4f528795189c9c4a3aca9c54b5ce8"><em>Change the text color in column A to white.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e428796a5713f71e230814067147b1bcc"><em>Format the cells in B2:C5 with a green background.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_insert_columns</code> – Inserts blank columns at a specific position in a Google Sheets sheet.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e9368ac881bb87b4e70af60a1981642b9">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3307853fb068e670140e92691ab4200b">Add space for new data in the middle of a sheet.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef28311851d564424f4ec942fb11f81f5">Insert columns between existing data sections.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7c731098d8b06176993b037988fd79f8">Prepare space for importing data.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e33b873f444fce9ad81a43d023a51868d">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8a6e56e8e72c46bf2381be23eb9fc572">
<code>count</code> – The number of columns to insert. Must be a positive integer.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2e55a1053ff53789409bdb63f969bbe2">
<code>sheetId</code> – The numeric ID of the sheet where columns will be inserted. Use the <code>google_sheets_get_spreadsheet</code> tool to find the sheet ID. This is not the sheet name or title.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e076366f86d9d6b5b92b696d4f31231a2">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2d6d261690970e83479dca63547a4547">
<code>startIndex</code> – The 0-based column index where columns will be inserted. Columns are inserted before this index. Example: <code>startIndex=3</code> inserts columns before column D (A=0, B=1, C=2, D=3).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e3b47491a3102e28a7bf4b3b5bff1adeb">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb84e92a2ee0d5566ecb80c13b32aab48"><em>Insert two columns before column D.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e9c4b86aed9522f7fa6c97f3f84d9dcf3"><em>Add a blank column before index 3.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e22e1459bd5e27711bbf0f54f738ca050"><em>Insert five new columns in the middle of my table.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_insert_rows</code> – Inserts blank rows at a specific position in a Google Sheets sheet.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8e4568c151c694589748336a19ab4146">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e4403bc566b7de11dec3540c2609f9798">Add space for new data in the middle of a sheet.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6d0dbf51955643e6fd1b71e72891a166">Insert rows between existing data sections.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee16a294d203b5ed383692a5c7c6e5e8b">Add blank rows for manual data entry.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="efd5cd58ec34abe1d5f9d192ca5dfb09c">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ee22476dce472c614a6aba5d4151548ee">
<code>count</code> – The number of rows to insert. Must be a positive integer.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ea4dbad1a30bc50ae3177bd34e3218041">
<code>sheetId</code> – The numeric ID of the sheet where rows will be inserted. Use the <code>google_sheets_get_spreadsheet</code> tool to find the sheet ID. This is not the sheet name or title.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3945ae00c609e4321f8709c77aec8829">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e57f41ad8fb4315a310327e91f22caa73">
<code>startIndex</code> – The 0-based index where rows will be inserted. Rows are inserted before this index. Example: <code>startIndex=5</code> inserts rows before row 6 (row indices start at 0).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebeae7801bb79ed9726c3c255b6941c0e">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e54773e509c08e2606bd0107ffe1a21bf"><em>Insert three rows before row 6.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e283c25b61275354f71c9b072d92d10ff"><em>Add a blank row at index 5.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e44949ff92cd747cf67e1085b5c3ada3e"><em>Insert empty rows above the totals line.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_update_values</code> – Updates values in a specified range of a Google Sheets spreadsheet.</summary></details><h4 id="h_01KQFZA1DAD0X1NAJBDMY0H2JT">Delete</h4><details><summary><code>google_sheets_delete_columns</code> – Deletes columns from a Google Sheets sheet.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e391719289ffbf2827d1b0135cef98bbc">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eeb9cd43c1193055aee562943e6b8c806">Remove obsolete or incorrect data columns.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec3d18dff16cd40030337de9cff0fbaca">Delete empty columns.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e23e477a9e79240de42153c356b9204ea">Reorganize sheet structure.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e8778134f88f7e408fc0bf9960a3038d5">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e72c34c3f29ffe5b9b70cca76bd50b78a">
<code>endIndex</code> – The 0-based index of the last column to delete (exclusive). Example: <code>endIndex=4</code> deletes up to but not including column E. To delete columns C–D (indices 2–3), use <code>startIndex=2, endIndex=4</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eeffe8ccf5ba2767f536318776351e085">
<code>sheetId</code> – The numeric ID of the sheet where columns will be deleted. Use the <code>google_sheets_get_spreadsheet</code> tool to find the sheet ID. This is not the sheet name or title.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec392f3322bf401554d93009ac2f79a52">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6cd4a9581749c04469deceb5536e3005">
<code>startIndex</code> – The 0-based index of the first column to delete (inclusive). Example: <code>startIndex=2</code> starts deleting from column C (A=0, B=1, C=2).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e51eac18eb48a3eb44e8bddbd07f4d951">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ef82b7a7856757994074d7cc3cc6e45e8"><em>Delete columns C and D from the sheet.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e34bf23201ca3c18c79aba03535ea1e9d"><em>Remove the first two columns from sheet ID 0.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e6929e7a7dcc962b4ad5ed26f7e5e0966"><em>Delete column index 4 entirely.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_delete_rows</code> – Deletes rows from a Google Sheets sheet.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e17182d8cd2df8b2c0ee29b22c537db49">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eea4aa5266ea147e1df3c00ade4aec35e">Remove obsolete or incorrect data rows.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3f17a85c8fa7e7edbb1564e04bea4ba9">Delete empty rows.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e8e19407b8828d184ab6c4adebfeb0145">Remove duplicate entries.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e266e9b52a2d00b8d060796fd4f9c474a">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="edc2034869a3e29ffcbf6dd3a3fc66f4b">
<code>endIndex</code> – The 0-based index of the last row to delete (exclusive). Example: <code>endIndex=8</code> deletes up to but not including row 9. To delete rows 6–8 (indices 5–7), use <code>startIndex=5, endIndex=8</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e4b6474362759c9bdcf0d89ada26b3a14">
<code>sheetId</code> – The numeric ID of the sheet where rows will be deleted. Use the <code>google_sheets_get_spreadsheet</code> tool to find the sheet ID. This is not the sheet name or title.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed5385e780a0a79bd6383a31eba325521">
<code>spreadsheetId</code> – The ID of the spreadsheet.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e213c779e7e134f00f3991495af2a73d8">
<code>startIndex</code> – The 0-based index of the first row to delete (inclusive). Example: <code>startIndex=5</code> starts deleting from row 6 (row indices start at 0).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e61f169292328c41f354c409951707e62">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="efe38e2cf1e3a860fcb8e2df379653651"><em>Delete row 5 from the spreadsheet.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec40a48809916923d2ec9ce99190d0102"><em>Remove the first 10 rows of test data.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eb83ad8b2e929045c0ceec764cdb8f6e7"><em>Delete rows index 5 through 8.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_sheets_delete_spreadsheet</code> – Deletes a Google Sheets spreadsheet permanently.</summary></details><h3 id="h_01KQD2JHEZCA08K94JVG8FXZWY">Google Slides<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KQD2JHEZCA08K94JVG8FXZWY"></a></h3><p>The following tools let you create, read, and modify Google Slides presentations programmatically. Use them to automate presentation tasks such as building slide decks from data, updating content across slides, or managing presentation structure. You need a Google account with access to Google Drive to use these tools.</p><h4 id="h_01KQFZA4TAYZNPYAMNWXDC0CQ9">Read</h4><details><summary><code>google_slides_find_presentation_by_name</code> – Search for Google Slides presentations by name in the user's Google Drive.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e65b563f50e3ab0afcac5a6e3b4709a13">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e0bb35e7f14c49d8170649845dc8471de">Find a presentation when you know the name but not the ID.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee5191b4552b0b9a9b02bc851532ea5ec">Locate presentations matching a keyword or partial name.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e781ae2e40e68ad374a1ed7fa275a6eaa">Get presentation ID for use in other operations.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e09f32940e9a9b549fde76e3cb1e2a603">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e14027c8208694b35709638b115fb86c1">
<code>name</code> – The name or partial name of the presentation to search for. For fuzzy matching, this can be any part of the title.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef1a36066e674c54d669b8fd04402be8e">(Optional) <code>exactMatch</code> – Whether to match the exact name (case-sensitive) or use fuzzy matching.<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e2fb7516defbcde78b32b845f21b81787">
<code>true</code> – Exact case-sensitive match only</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5f041707068701ae0d78449783b369ec">
<code>false</code> (default) – Fuzzy search that finds presentations containing the search term</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e45f4c9695c9833713c087da2037adfc2">(Optional) <code>maxResults</code> – Maximum number of presentations to return. Default is 10. Increase if you expect many matches.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebc529a61026274f7d1d00552b7054588">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e4f13f8949699ebaefc77ac9602fbd59b"><em>Search for the "Q4 Marketing Plan" presentation.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e840da2a264a182331ac3fdd245c32173"><em>Find presentation IDs matching "Weekly Sync".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ee475d96ed461c84a6981b0d9c23bc101"><em>Look up the presentation exactly called "Client Pitch Template".</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_slides_get_presentation</code> – Gets the latest version and complete details of the specified Google Slides presentation.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2fb003d03eec2763969254d182232cae">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e2267e771cabb0cd7a8ef5c5cae689393">Inspect presentation structure and content.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee3bcf8c42844b1623fd63a85537758e1">Get list of all slides and their IDs.</li>

</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_slides_create_image</code> – Creates an image on a slide from a provided URL.</summary><div><ul>

<li data-list-item-id="e7c888f18dcd03981da3beab1caf473ad">

</li>

<li data-list-item-id="eefbd9a69f0f5f7c97599d9d31e696547">
<code>searchText</code> – The text to search for and replace.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e10e11e4e0983df17fdecdc2f7413a31e">(Optional) <code>matchCase</code> – Whether to match case when searching for text. Defaults to false.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ebe2cddfe866c3c6647e387584de9443f">(Optional) <code>pageObjectIds</code> – Array of page object IDs to limit the search to (JSON string). If not provided, searches entire presentation.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e3b3e8fb8a0103d31700b67714c7b065a">(Optional) <code>searchByRegex</code> – Whether to treat the search text as a regular expression. Defaults to false.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eba17fd191135c976d701d4e339354135">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e6247820914a5e4ad1d66bccf39ec62de"><em>Replace all instances of "Acme" with "Initech" on slides 1 and 2.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="efc65368a1f9ff412c5ced07328d1ce79"><em>Use regex to update all 2023 dates to 2024 dates.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e2ae65f4a557ef03838ef8789ffc8c2b1"><em>Swap out the placeholder {{name}} with "John" using case-sensitive matching.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_slides_replace_text</code> – Replaces all instances of text matching search criteria throughout a presentation.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e1e7fd513f5482ab3633a5f4738f06efc">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8c6f5a3641479af8592657a8eb40e3ef">Replace an exact word or phrase across every slide in a presentation.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e54ea00a7a50ddba4badc680d57cbeef5">Update placeholder text, company names, or product names using simple text matching.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e78575a393c453e517fcb6d05a141c70a">Perform bulk text updates across an entire presentation without regex or slide-level scoping.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e3bb0a091f4d5c22b036d76849e1643ac">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e7f0916e78d30246ddbf5b7310cf79ed0">
<code>presentationId</code> – The ID of the presentation where text should be replaced.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb8656ed7d1af4e5bae7f46b5054ed4fc">
<code>replaceText</code> – The text to replace the search text with.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e49e15f642940834587a9cb3cd4766885">
<code>searchText</code> – The text to search for and replace.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="efdbf514fc70273234aec4f80f6d0de26">(Optional) <code>matchCase</code> – Whether to match case when searching for text. Defaults to false.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e9dee282ed58569ef15a259634c0b85cd">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e17642e3ddfababfe3390fe1b7226109c"><em>Replace every instance of "Draft" with "Final".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea85c5dd9660ebb521d7b0fc713aeb7f2"><em>Case-sensitively substitute "TBD" with "Q4 2024".</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="edeefcc4025620bbbdc44da02db9a1ed9"><em>Find "Client Name" and change it to "Acme Corp" in the whole deck.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h4 id="h_01KQFZAGJ0F1YX8TYWSS1MV9XJ">Advanced</h4><details><summary><code>google_slides_create_image</code> – Creates an image on a slide from a provided URL.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e969b85f4423c1bd7d8419d24031fa523">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e19f458095d7ab0ab4759b6a8908e5231">Add logos, photos, or diagrams to slides.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee7e725cedf76d85cee8c9b8e7a7ae2d8">Insert charts or graphs from external sources.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e13fed9687e3febdf8c1a6954664d005b">Include visual content from web resources.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e27d220ddd668e27627bcea08b371fd22">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ec4c98c53cedd97aeba04c438fc599aa5">
<code>presentationId</code> – The ID of the presentation to add the image to.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec9e75740994be0703a1eb49d98d5d74e">
<code>slideId</code> – The ID of the slide to add the image to.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7ee8ac5aad8724a5a5e934250612b1f4">
<code>url</code> – The URL of the image to insert. Must be publicly accessible and under 50MB.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e85f9cda89a338983c6c682ce8aa08559">(Optional) <code>height</code> – The height of the image in points. Defaults to 300.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6c0594baf3db3ff31b59303db6b73d3d">(Optional) <code>objectId</code> – A user-supplied object ID for the image. If specified, must be unique among all pages and page elements in the presentation. Must start with an alphanumeric character or underscore, followed by alphanumeric characters, underscore, hyphen or colon. Length must be 5-50 characters. If not provided, a unique ID is generated.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9a9e379911958c7c35761930b641ad7e">(Optional) <code>width</code> – The width of the image in points. Defaults to 400.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e6540ef0161981bf650279fa571ee94b3">(Optional) <code>x</code> – The x-coordinate position of the image in points. Defaults to 100.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e65ba862ab30df9b699539562d9869541">(Optional) <code>y</code> – The y-coordinate position of the image in points. Defaults to 100.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebb3e1d111673a972547710ef2c1d3d9a">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e80fcb0db5f3081fc53314777059d1ac6"><em>Add the logo from https://example.com/logo.png to slide 2.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea369e2613e84b94c9775a53aa6bbae56"><em>Insert this image URL at position x=50, y=100.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e66c3384b224c346b365db6dd66bf745d"><em>Put a new image on the title slide with a width of 400.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_slides_create_table</code> – Creates a new table on a slide with specified rows and columns.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="eae07ce81d36e863d7c211d4ec9ecda16">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e3c5222cb7b6c2191d2c436852cb9c0c2">Display data in tabular format.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5f8e5b13f04b248fd36d84c338411a90">Create comparison matrices.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2c2c1b704923dd5993ec2c143562b3d7">Show schedules or timelines.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee43264d0c54be261cfb1bb101f5f9cc9">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8ec46bfe34c3a29c8bcdd9073750c7f3">
<code>columns</code> – Number of columns in the table.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e904494c0fd2602d1fecbc0793cfba06c">
<code>presentationId</code> – The ID of the presentation to add the table to.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5eb42c99bd270b4b936c909bfb4178f4">
<code>rows</code> – Number of rows in the table.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e7ec611b3cf3fababa6deadf305cfee6d">
<code>slideId</code> – The ID of the slide to add the table to.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ed405d8f7e0a6fbe810de4b48f6fb1a76">(Optional) <code>height</code> – The height of the table in points. Defaults to 300.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef46b8c57e3bdbc81efe93fa4d9f1098b">(Optional) <code>objectId</code> – A user-supplied object ID for the table. If specified, must be unique among all pages and page elements in the presentation. Must start with an alphanumeric character or underscore, followed by alphanumeric characters, underscore, hyphen or colon. Length must be 5-50 characters. If not provided, a unique ID is generated.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2e40714271682e9667047b15a2c0028b">(Optional) <code>width</code> – The width of the table in points. Defaults to 400.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e546dbac2ebe9b31ed0fedd2691d70902">(Optional) <code>x</code> – The x-coordinate position of the table in points. Defaults to 100.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e51de19ed533a52aff0406657ea1f68ac">(Optional) <code>y</code> – The y-coordinate position of the table in points. Defaults to 100.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ef48f851f0203fb523f446912eafa300f">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e74b7827b2635fdecdd76bb75c4a01cb8"><em>Add a 3x3 table to the second slide.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e3e28c494957e4d3599bdcca60c30f546"><em>Create a table with 5 rows and 4 columns on slide xyz.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ec9883720532c5224ee2145c479f08d41"><em>Insert a new table at x: 50, y: 150 coordinates.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_slides_delete_text</code> – Deletes text from a shape or table cell in a Google Slides presentation.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e0ead9f95ed66675d650eb4c2a032cf8a">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e40f8e1072dc9a9a181ffc3454a792353">Remove specific text sections from elements.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1e36dd80f6d8d5782143b8cd20eab8d1">Clear content from text boxes or shapes.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e83986d66831976017b8d3a3049081ba2">Delete text from table cells.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ee938ebe6ead67c644ad9ff8754bb1ac9">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eafa533d956e7391700edcae89739c31d">
<code>objectId</code> – The object ID of the shape or table from which the text will be deleted.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e73f2072ef22e311992bea7a5b3457c48">
<code>presentationId</code> – The ID of the presentation containing the text.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1844471b8aaaf9b3716979710b5ccef2">
<code>textRange</code> – The range of text to delete (JSON string with <code>type</code>, <code>startIndex</code>, <code>endIndex</code>). Valid types – <code>FIXED_RANGE</code>, <code>FROM_START_INDEX</code>, <code>ALL</code>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e41d3da5aa7cc498bff6f8bb2e4ee7e37">(Optional) <code>cellLocation</code> – The optional table cell location if the text is to be deleted from a table cell (JSON string with rowIndex and columnIndex).</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ecbe27a5391d7c192975dd776c233d26d">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ea8517408d92ce92cfd2df4986de3bb36"><em>Delete all text inside text box xyz.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ebac908aaaa2dec60ff8a09655daf36c5"><em>Clear the text from cell row 1 column 2 in table abc.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e01faa09bfc9645b27024e8d00e5890d6"><em>Remove the first 10 characters from shape 123.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_slides_replace_image</code> – Replaces an existing image with a new image from a URL.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ed2cc1b5ab9ca75b90375d05d1d7d61b9">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ed7b4a86421a26f63141a2b263cf8e5cd">Update outdated images with new versions.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edcfe888fcde12a3c8dd31569bad8eba5">Swap placeholder images with final versions.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e0791fb22d9947cfff572d646573136ea">Replace logos or branding elements.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ecd18e2cf9f7cf9b27d9d04a1d83392a5">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e67269ffa96d9a86a1493e69175e65928">
<code>imageObjectId</code> – The ID of the existing image that will be replaced.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e5c2ee6da7c2418e8405e6818bac0d7c8">
<code>presentationId</code> – The ID of the presentation containing the image to replace.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb35c41a137d297107f979e01cbd72140">
<code>url</code> – The URL of the new image. Must be publicly accessible and under 50MB.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e00ad65b7b7adea1e5788379abf45ad9d">(Optional) <code>imageReplaceMethod</code> – The replacement method. Defaults to <code>CENTER_INSIDE</code>. Options:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e221d63038abbf4545959b9503e16aaad"> <code>CENTER_INSIDE</code> – Fit within bounds.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec9314d4e909de806711f53e9f9a85274"> <code>CENTER_CROP</code> – Fill bounds.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="ebf482ef93abfa81554126968cb4032bd">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="ebde7fb8060e2726270822623e86239a0"><em>Replace image xyz123 with logo.png url and use CENTER_INSIDE method.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e315990f5374969eba19da4b4234ae4b1"><em>Swap the old screenshot with this new URL.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e258801dfb0905c61f22bc81bcf697e7c"><em>Update the logo image without changing its position.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><details><summary><code>google_slides_update_slides_position</code> – Updates the position of slides in the presentation by moving them to a new index.</summary><div><ul>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e2ed7fca401cc374fcc44d96f63d96a7d">
<strong>When to use</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef02941ca70d586676f09a703fdb4a07c">Reorganize content flow to improve narrative or logical sequence.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="edfb10a8f8b28d30bfd1d061343d3afc4">Move intro/outro slides to the beginning or end.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9e4c02c7419f6d3157f40a23f704fca9">Group related slides thematically together.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e6ddf9f7a11921afdf9b4dde0ad7a5e02">
<strong>Parameters</strong><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="efbc49d84b0e947197ecefd199ccf8f5d">
<code>insertionIndex</code> – The position where the slides will be inserted, counted from zero (0 = first position; an index equal to the total slide count moves slides to the end). Slides are inserted before the slide currently at that index. Examples:<ul>
<li data-list-item-id="e8bb013d6bd097dd7fcd923d06cea034c">
<code>0</code> – Move to beginning.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e36ad13e689153c5190dc438c789050af">
<code>1</code> – Move to second position.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9ddac8cc0cc35e996e67708574d3fc14">
<code>10</code> – Move to 11th position.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1448c2edc4e143101c4b97ab4e664ef8">
<code>20</code> – Move to end of a 20-slide presentation.</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb964bc928622fb20885db619d80a3903">
<code>presentationId</code> – The ID of the presentation containing the slides to move. </li>
<li data-list-item-id="e9de0988a821880269f9c10d27adb80bc">
<code>slideObjectIds</code> – Comma-separated string of slide IDs to move, listed in their current presentation order with no duplicates. Use the <code>google_slides_get_presentation</code> tool to retrieve slide IDs and their current order. Example: <code>slide_3,slide_4,slide_5</code>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="wysiwyg-list-bold" data-list-item-id="e25a1cfa896c6b96c1bcab7bfbd725600">
<strong>Example prompts</strong><ul>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="e36484470ac1f7acdccfdfebac610b82f"><em>Move slide 5 and slide 6 to the beginning of the presentation.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eca4e28fb9b28f56c9a9ca061b5166c2e"><em>Send the title slide to index 0.</em></li>
<li class="ck-list-marker-italic" data-list-item-id="eddeaa1bba2698dae27b60e96c43c029d"><em>Rearrange slides by moving slide ids "slide_4,slide_5" to index 2.</em></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></details><h2 id="h_01KQFJTYB0QEB6JVH4TCKMRTZ3">Configure instance level Opal OAuth<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01KQFJTYB0QEB6JVH4TCKMRTZ3"></a></h2><div class="important">Configure this <em>only</em> if your organization manages its own OAuth provider. Most administrators can skip this section.</div><div class="important"> </div><div class="important">In the OCP <strong>App Directory</strong>, complete the following steps:</div><ol>
<li data-list-item-id="eaaae847d813a09ef8dcb232b87e572f8">Click the <strong>Settings</strong> tab of the Google Workspace Tool.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec47f487458aa8508e9e46000f6f144d0">Expand the <strong>Google Workspace Settings</strong> section.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e323fe2f8169cb55788d95074cd3bb653">Toggle <strong>Instance level Opal OAuth</strong> on if you want to use a custom Google Workspace authentication provider connection.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ecb8e9b76849e7459fd37b0ce8f2495b4">Enter your <strong>Google Workspace Auth Provider ID</strong>.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e71c4264d5b8bbcb3fdeeb6e72596272f">
<p>Click <strong>Save</strong>.</p>
<figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1230/1092;" src="/hc/article_attachments/45471460052877" alt="Screenshot of Google Workspace Settings in OCP where the Instance level Opal OAuth toggle and Google Workspace Auth Provider ID field are visible" width="1230" height="1092" class="img-enlargable"></figure>
</li>
</ol><div class="note"><p>If you use Opti ID, administrators can turn off generative AI in the Opti ID Admin Center. See <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36402464751501" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Turn generative AI off across Optimizely applications</a>.</p></div>

<template id="tmpl-article-list">
  <div class="border-top border-bottom lg:border-transparent my-5" x-data="toggle({ isOpen: false })" @collapse:show.stop="open" @collapse:hide.stop="close">

    
    <h3 class="flex align-items-center justify-content-between my-4 font-size-lg cursor-pointer lg:hidden" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#sidebar-article-navigation" aria-controls="sidebar-article-navigation" aria-expanded="false">
      Categories
      <svg class="fill-current pointer-events-none ml-3" :class="isOpen && 'rotate-180'" width="14px" viewBox="0 0 40 20" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <path d="M20,19.5 C19.4,19.5 18.9,19.3 18.4,18.9 L1.4,4.9 C0.3,4 0.2,2.4 1.1,1.4 C2,0.3 3.6,0.2 4.6,1.1 L20,13.8 L35.5,1.1 C36.6,0.2 38.1,0.4 39,1.4 C39.9,2.5 39.7,4 38.7,4.9 L21.7,18.9 C21.1,19.3 20.5,19.5 20,19.5 Z" fill-rule="nonzero"></path>
      </svg>
    </h3>

    <div class="collapse lg:expand lg:flex-column" id="sidebar-article-navigation">
      <ul class="list-unstyled font-size-lg w-full">
        <% categories.forEach(function(category, index) { %>
          <li class="font-semibold" x-data="toggle({ isOpen: <%= !!category.isActive %> })" @collapse:show.stop="open" @collapse:hide.stop="close">

            
            <div class="flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
              <a class="flex-1 py-3 text-inherit" :class="{ 'text-inherit': !isOpen }" href="<%= category.html_url %>">
                <%= category.name %>
              </a>
              <button class="p-2 ml-1 not-a-button border-radius transition cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-200 hidden lg:block" :class="{ 'is-active': isOpen }" :aria-expanded="isOpen" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#category-<%= category.id %>">
                <svg class="text-inherit fill-current pointer-events-none" :class="{ 'rotate-180': isOpen }" width="12px" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 324 190" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
                  <path d="M162,190 C156,190 150,187 146,183 L7,38 C-2,29 -2,15 7,7 C16,-2 30,-2 39,7 L162,135 L285,7 C293,-2 308,-2 317,7 C326,15 326,29 317,38 L178,183 C174,187 168,190 162,190 Z"></path>
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div class="hidden lg:block">
              
              <%= partial('partial-article-list-sections', {
                id: 'category-' + category.id,
                parentId: '#sidebar-article-navigation',
                sections: category.sections,
                activeCategoryId: activeCategoryId,
                activeSectionId: activeSectionId,
                activeArticleId: activeArticleId,
                partial: partial
              }) %>
            </div>
          </li>
        <% }); %>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>

<template id="tmpl-partial-article-list-sections">
  <% if (sections.length) { %>
    <ul class="list-none pl-3 mb-0 font-size-base collapse" id="<%= id %>" :class="{ 'is-visible': isOpen }" data-parent="<%= parentId %>">
      <% sections.forEach(function(section) { %>
        <li class="font-medium" x-data="toggle({ isOpen: <%= !!section.isActive %> })" @collapse:show.stop="open" @collapse:hide.stop="close">

          
          <div class="flex justify-content-between align-items-center">
            <a class="flex-1 py-2 text-inherit font-semibold" :class="{ 'text-inherit': !isOpen }" href="<%= section.html_url %>">
              <%= section.name %>
            </a>
            <button class="p-2 ml-1 not-a-button border-radius transition cursor-pointer hover:bg-gray-200" :class="{ 'is-active': isOpen }" :aria-expanded="isOpen" data-toggle="collapse" data-target="#section-<%= section.id %>">
              <svg class="text-inherit fill-current pointer-events-none" :class="{ 'rotate-180': isOpen }" width="12px" height="12px" viewBox="0 0 324 190" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true">
                <path d="M162,190 C156,190 150,187 146,183 L7,38 C-2,29 -2,15 7,7 C16,-2 30,-2 39,7 L162,135 L285,7 C293,-2 308,-2 317,7 C326,15 326,29 317,38 L178,183 C174,187 168,190 162,190 Z"></path>
              </svg>
            </button>
          </div>

          
          <%= partial('partial-article-list-sections', {
            id: 'section-' + section.id,
            parentId: '#' + id,
            sections: section.sections,
            activeCategoryId: activeCategoryId,
            activeSectionId: activeSectionId,
            activeArticleId: activeArticleId,
            partial: partial
          }) %>

          
          <% if (section.articles.length) { %>
            <ul class="list-none font-size-md pl-0 mb-0 collapse" :class="{ 'is-visible': isOpen }" id="section-<%= section.id %>" data-parent="#<%= id %>">
              <% section.articles.forEach(function(article) { %>
                <li>
                  <a class="block px-3 py-2 text-inherit border-radius transition<% if (article.isActive) { %> bg-gray-100<% } %>" href="<%= article.html_url %>">
                    <%= article.title %>
                  </a>
                </li>
              <% }); %>
            </ul>
          <% } %>

        </li>
      <% }); %>
    </ul>
  <% } %>
</template>


<template id="tmpl-partial-section-list-sections">
  <% if (sections.length) { %>
    <ul class="list-unstyled font-size-md<% if (parent.hasOwnProperty('parent_section_id')) { %> pl-4 mb-0<% } %>">
      <% sections.slice(0, maxSections).forEach(function(section) { %>
        <li>
          <a class="block py-2 text-inherit<% if (section.isActive) { %> border-left border-left-primary border-left-4 -ml-4 pl-3<% } %>" href="<%= section.html_url %>">
            <%= section.name %>
          </a>
          <%= partial('partial-section-list-sections', { parent: section, sections: section.sections, maxSections: maxSections, partial: partial }) %>
        </li>
      <% }); %>
      <% if (sections.length > maxSections) { %>
        <li>
          <a class="block py-2 text-inherit" href="<%= parent.html_url %>">
            See more
          </a>
        </li>
      <% } %>
    </ul>
  <% } %>
</template>
